entries.c981189727ea93d51331355dfc63be66ba4dfea6: In 2023, the Supply Service launched public tender No. 23-19957 for a service contract for the household maintenance of the Biosphere. This type of service for the Biosphere is usually entrusted to a private company. This case concerns the exercise of the first year of option of extension of the contract, covering the period from November 1, 2026 to October 31, 2027.
entries.74c24f181d77ab5a5075a8f2f647d26acb194401: To award a contract to Recyc-Matelas Inc. for the collection, transportation and valorization services of mattresses and spring boxes from the ecocentres of the Montréal agglomeration, for a period of 28 months - Total expenditure of $734,690.25 including taxes - Public tender 26-21421 (2 som.)
entries.e18f6e71100fc4762529a6f8f6e9329192b4f6d9: Pursuant to section 16 and subsection 6 of section 19 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (RLRQ, chapter E-20.001), the disposal and recovery of residual materials, as well as any other part of their management if they are hazardous, are agglomeration jurisdiction. Under section 17 of the Act, the central municipality may act with respect to residual materials constituting the agglomeration jurisdiction not only within its territory but also over that of any other related municipality. The Environmental and Ecological Transition Service (ETS) of the City of Montreal assumes this responsibility for the agglomeration.
entries.c6bdb615233a11ed7d06a22649a57c9ed2d4c380: Exercising the option of the second six-month extension / Authorize an additional expenditure of $3,269,055.43, including taxes, for composting or biomethanizing food waste treatment services under two contracts awarded to Recyclage Notre-Dame inc. (CG25 0030), increasing the total contract amount to $13,730,032.81, including taxes
entries.7fbf60d8e47a80e3a848f569fe49ad84648ba5ef: Under section 16 and subsection 6 of section 19 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (R.S.Q.;chapter E-20. 001, Act 75), the disposal and recovery of residual materials is an agglomeration jurisdiction. Under section 17 of the Act, the central municipality may act with respect to residual materials constituting the agglomeration jurisdiction not only within its territory but also over that of any other related municipality. The Environmental and Ecological Transition Service of the City of Montreal assumes this responsibility for the agglomeration.
entries.fc30d2e2408f57c719d24112ebf02fe3e0b95a8e: Contract with Les Entreprises Cogenex inc. for the reconstruction and rehabilitation of valve chambers at various locations on the Montréal agglomeration main water system - Total expenditure of $3,729,406.95, including taxes - Public tender DRE-P2629-205377-C (6 som.)
entries.a02275ebb01dd27701685cf1ab7d8cdc16989b2c: The City of Montreal's Water Service (WS) is responsible for providing drinking water to the Montréal community, managing stormwater and cleaning wastewater in order to protect health, ensure public safety, and preserve the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate (WSD) is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater by carrying out projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. The work covered by this file concerns the reconstruction and rehabilitation of valve chambers of water pipes with diameters ranging from 300 mm to 400 mm at various locations on the main water system in the Montréal agglomeration.
entries.687972870e49aa128d06cf152c0363b06dc52d13: Contract with La Cie Électrique Britton Ltd. to upgrade electrical equipment in blocks B and G of the sewage treatment plant sludge building Jean-R.-Marcotte Phase 1 - Total expenditure of $1,334,501.03 including taxes - Public tender DEEU-SP2630-190976-C (11 som.)
entries.85e19b5519f9d36aaf05037583871ffcff64751b: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater, ensure public health and safety, and protect the environment today and for future generations. Within this service, the Department of Wastewater Treatment (DEEU) is responsible for intercepting and remediating the sewage, storm and industrial waste on the Island of Montreal. Its activities contribute to the protection of public health, the safety of the population and the preservation of the environment.
entries.5d88fdddba2b8e3b2e4e67c2fc8717a81ccd8c3b: Grant a contract to Les architectes Labonté Marcil s.e.n.c., for professional architectural and engineering services as part of the renovation project for Barracks 43 of the Service de sécurité feuille de Montréal, in the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville - Total expenditure of $940,827.76, taxes included - Public tender 26-21398 (4 som.)
entries.633f43879fea7e0958744d1c5a59e8712bf97980: The project concerns Barracks 43, a building built in 1949 and occupied by the Service de sécurité feuille de Montréal (SIM). The building has an important index of age and a significant deterioration in the slab of the garage. In 2015, the condition of the structure necessitated the installation of sidings.
entries.b7eaf10b0253f1d56ddd50a2dad4e7d9d27ccc6f: Conclude framework agreements with consulting firms AECOM inc. (Lot 1) and Terrapex Environnement ltée (Lot 2) for professional services for environmental and geotechnical studies, plans and specifications, requests for ministerial authorizations, soil monitoring and construction of biogas mitigation and post-construction follow-up measures for construction at abandoned waste disposal sites for 36 months, including a 12-month extension option - Estimated amount of agreements: $4,074,664.97, including taxes - Call for tenders 26-21372 (7 Som.)
entries.c42b390fe7d01bc826c9d46937dfdd42db460c2e: The City of Montreal has identified more than 110 decommissioned waste disposal sites in its territory, also known as former quarries and surface deposits, consisting of contaminated soils and residual materials that may generate biogas and may generate leachate affecting groundwater. These MRLs may have been developed on their surface, such as parks, streets or buildings.
entries.8adbc2d126b61bf243e9e5ac6068c21c059947c7: Approve the proposed agreement to operate a restaurant, free of charge, between the City of Montreal and the Café des Amis, for a term of three years, effective May 1, 2026, for premises with an area of 268.96 square metres, on the ground floor and basement of the building located at 1196 Camilien-Houde Road, in the borough of Ville-Marie. The total amount of the real estate subsidy for this occupation is estimated at $133,445.07
entries.7dd369c1cc6dbd6fc522e9a5d9d408c12ea38c1b: Since June 16, 2017, the City of Montreal (City) has been lending to Café des Amis (Café), a space on the ground floor of the Chalet du Mont-Royal (Chalet), located at 1196, chemin Camillien-Houde in Montreal, to operate a catering service. This food service in Mont-Royal Park is a branch of the Friends of the Mountain organization. At the end of the loan contract for premises in 2020 and at the request of the Legal Affairs Service, the latter was replaced by an operating agreement for a restaurant including the addition of a space in the basement.
entries.1a5e7e5e7523b189c25b1bf318b6152dd453bb17: Grant $90,000 in financial support to Le réseau d'aide aux personnes soulières et voitables de Montréal inc., for the holding of editions 2026, 2027 and 2028 of La Nuit des sans-abri de Montréal / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.e5ede3ea25da7327e5aac73087b2e25879894406: La Nuit des sans-abri (NSA MTL) is an annual roaming awareness event held in Montreal since 1989. It takes place simultaneously in several municipalities in Quebec on the third Friday of October. The Réseau d'aide aux personnes soulières et itinerantes de Montréal (hereinafter RAPSIM) has been coordinating the event in Montreal since 2022 and is recognized by the community homelessness community.
entries.38144fc0077f3673d89b44b45cb4a7f47a1f5ada: Provide $280,000 in financial support to Maison de l'innovation sociale (MIS), for the implementation of the "MIS Incubator" project, for the period September 1, 2026 to August 31, 2028, as part of the Reflex Agreement 3 (2025-2029) with the Ministry of Economy, Innovation and Energy / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.5c05c8d253de54b60bdab8db2dcf821a90f5e2af: Founded in 2016, Maison de l'innovation sociale (MIS) is a not-for-profit organization whose mission is to propel the process of social innovation. It supports citizen collectives, organizations and collective entrepreneurs in the development of projects with social impact in the initiation phase. The City of Montreal has been supporting the organization for several years, notably through a contribution of $578,250 granted for the realization of the Civic Incubator during the period 2023-2026.
entries.72799c148272c32c271bc0c47510a43fb7669d86: Exercise the option of the second 12-month extension, without additional expenditure, for multidisciplinary professional services in the design and supervision of municipal infrastructure works under the contract awarded to Stantec Consultants Ltd. (CG23 0158)
entries.60a455ad36f28cd061bffb021e37f0ee130e977a: The Ville de Montréal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean up wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. Major Projects Directorate (MDP) projects, including the Ozone Disinfection Project at Jean-R.-Marcotte Station and the McTavish Pumping Station Rehabilitation Project, require ad hoc professional services for expert mandates on aspects not otherwise covered by specific contracts for design and monitoring of works. It is also required to be able to rely on counter-expertise services in certain cases where technical issues are complex or require validation tools that the City does not have.
entries.d6a50a46bf98a346070a3536753dc0857241d9e6: Grant an OTC contract to Sports Montréal Inc., for the management services of the Montreal Games, for editions 2027 to 2029 - Total expenditure of $1,347,010.35, including taxes / Approve draft agreement to this effect
entries.307440e6988a02f28fe1fe09f708f526e22d2d5e: Heritage of the Montreal Summer Olympic Games in 1976, the Montreal Games were held for the first time in 1978. Their main objective is to organize a sporting event for young Montrealers and Montrealers from boroughs and related cities enrolled in an initiation program. The event allows athletes to experience a first large-scale competition in high-level facilities.
entries.e59fcbb7f41b933cdb1d46ec05745c880d173a90: Approve the draft agreement by which the City mandates Hydro-Québec to bury the existing electricity system at the Fort Lorette archaeological site, as part of the development project for a future park, in the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville, partially funded by the Montreal Cultural Development Agreement - Total expenditure of $589,539.17, including taxes
entries.205b06d43f593c8c35774ef987a5271a59a56258: The City of Montreal wishes to develop a public park on the Fort Lorette Heritage Site, in order to highlight the history and riparian landscape of this site for the benefit of citizens. The property, located near the Prairie River in the district of Ahuntsic-Cartierville, was acquired by the City in 2018, due to its exceptional historical, archaeological and landscape interest, as well as in response to the mobilization of the community calling for its protection. In the same year, the Quebec Ministry of Culture and Communications classified this place as a heritage site, given the national importance of archaeological discoveries carried out, associated with a 17th century Sulpician mission.
entries.93224208dc4c103e5d1c9286e278cd714d4229ce: Approve the proposed restaurant operating agreement, free of charge, between the City of Montreal and the Café des Amis, for a three-year term, effective May 1, 2026, for premises with an area of 162.1 square metres, on the 1st floor of the building located in 2000, Remembrance Road, in the borough of Ville-Marie. entries.4db1deb122221c10b864cfcbc2f6038194118e23: The Ville de Montréal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. entries.1fbfe8253297a5dd0350c6e09438bdcf56e0623c: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montreal community, manage stormwater and sanitize wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety while protecting the environment, today and for future generations. The Drinking Water Directorate (DEP) and the Wastewater Treatment Directorate (WWTP) are planning the maintenance and repair of lifting equipment located at the Water Service's facilities. These facilities include six (6) potable water plants, eleven (11) tanks, five (5) overpressure stations, one (1) sewage treatment plant and several relief stations.
entries.88b6fcf9188289993bc29231e9a896f069557d39: Contract with 9103-7143 Québec inc. for technical services to control populations of Virginia deer in the Pointe-aux-Prairies Nature Park area for a period of seven months - Total expenditure of $236,675.80, including taxes - Public tender 26-21442 (1 sum)
entries.f0c75792610f5feffa094119ebe09592e6b2082b: The Service Espace pour la vie, grands parcs et Mont-Royal (SEPVGPMR) requires the services of a wildlife management firm to carry out all stages related to deer collection in the Pointe-aux-Prairies Nature Park area. This contract is intended to implement the recommendations of the technical and scientific committee set up in 2022 following the study report commissioned by the City of Montreal in 2020 at the Centre d'études sur le forêt (CEF) to assess the situation and methods of management. In 2024, the committee recommended that an operation be carried out to reduce livestock size, using professional shooters, in order to achieve a density which tends towards five deer/km2.

entries.367af45dfb82bf3e1c4e45f6b86570f8dc11347f: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. entries.9904ba64557ef125c65652a1829425dff2c8b56d: The City of Montreal's water department is responsible for providing drinking water to the Montréal community, managing stormwater and remediating wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, today and for future generations. Among these infrastructures, interception works are critical assets that provide hydraulic control, flow diversion, energy dissipation, access to main lines and maintenance of the operational integrity of the sewerage system.

Jean-R.-Marcotte Wastewater Treatment Station (the Station) provides treatment for all of Montreal Island's sanitary wastewater, as well as stormwater from unit systems. To further improve the quality of treated water and reduce microbiological contamination in the St. Lawrence River, an ozone disinfection process will be added at the end of the existing treatment.

entries.66ba25a9824a395564413a1380633d8f3ff11c98: In 2021, the Ministère de la Sécurité publique granted the City of Montreal a maximum financial contribution of $3,016,000 over a three-year period (2021-2024) to support the creation of the Section spécialisé en violence conjugale (SSVC) within the Service de police de Montréal (SPVM). This initiative aimed at setting up a specialized team dedicated to dealing with cases of high-risk domestic violence. Its deployment was part of a government commitment to prevent femicides, improve individual support for victims and strengthen surveillance of offenders.
entries.a2d285e6ce62588cff738e85e509cdd54a7ad9a8: Authorize the receipt of a grant of $2,978,100 from the Department of Homeland Security, for funding from the Integrated Pimping Team and the Integrated Child Pornography Team, for the period April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027 / Authorize an equivalent additional revenue and expense budget for $2026 of $2,233,600, as well as an adjustment to the subsequent year's budget base / Authorize the temporary increase in the authorized strength of 14 police positions for the same period / Authorize the creation of a temporary civilian position for the same period
entries.5bae0a61ef25b959bc062802c59baf5e862aa599: As part of the renewal of the Government's Action Plan to Combat the Sexual Exploitation of Minors (PACSESM) 2026-2029, the Ministry of Homeland Security has confirmed the extension of funding for specialized police initiatives aimed at combating sexual exploitation of minors. The renewal of the PACSESM responds to the recommendations of the Special Commission on the Sexual Exploitation of Minors and continues government efforts around four areas of intervention: awareness-raising and prevention, intervention and training, repression, reconstruction and rehabilitation. The targeted funding is specifically targeted in the Repression axis, whose aim is to combat exploiters and criminal networks involved in the sexual exploitation of minors.
entries.5116c79b4ec01dd22e8079f4956585ed17bb0826: Provide $382,000 in financial support to the Société de transport de Montréal and $120,000 to the Société du parc Jean-Drapeau for additional measures and services to be deployed at the UCI 2026 Road World Championships / Approve draft agreements to this effect
entries.e942afb8836a688f170cc69c1ed4ea2447be9d32: In 2026, Montreal will host the Union Cycliste Internationale's (UCI) Road World Championships, an international event that positions the city as an innovative and attractive sports hub. The holding of this major event involves hosting a significant number of spectators, delegations and media, generating considerable pressure on the road network and urban infrastructure, particularly in the sensitive area of Jean-Drapeau Park and the major roads in the city. To ensure the logistical success of the event, to ensure public safety and to minimize the environmental impact of travel, the City of Montréal must coordinate an enhanced public transportation offer adapted to the configuration of race routes.
entries.bed8a10df8fb65ec9e9d147e76c4285df47033c2: Provide $500,000 in financial support to Microcredit Montréal, for the project "Microcredit for inclusive entrepreneurship", for the period 2026-2029, under the agreement Réflexe 3 (Joint Economic Planning 2025-2029) concluded with the Ministry of Economy, Innovation and Energy / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.fb5b6a0f18d1279eee15fa6e86ace8797d41e671: The City of Montreal is committed to promoting access and participation in the economic life of the entire population. This commitment includes support for reducing territorial inequalities and strengthening the participation of entrepreneurs from under-represented groups. It is in this context that this application for a $500,000 financial contribution, submitted by Microcredit Montréal, is part of the "Microcredit for Inclusive Entrepreneurship" project.
entries.88e141bfc069a1f0107fb756ca0b62ffc38a199e: Provide $1,500,000 in financial support to the École polytechnique de Montréal for the project to develop clean technology scale laboratories for businesses at 5600 Hochelaga Street, Mercier-Hochelaga-Maisonneuve borough, for the Clean Technology Innovation Centre, for the period 2026-2029, as part of the Réflexe 3 agreement (2025-2029) with the Ministère de l'Économie, de l'Innovation et de l'Énergie / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.45f22ffe02b33233afab4dd8689ac5e6d5968d10: Founded in 1873, Polytechnique Montréal is one of Canada's largest engineering universities and has a leading position in research and innovation in Quebec. Through its 116 research units, recognized faculty expertise and a wide network of industrial, institutional and scientific partners, it actively contributes to the development of technological solutions responding to major economic, environmental and societal challenges. In addition to its mission of higher education and research, Polytechnique Montréal plays an important role in transferring knowledge to companies and supporting innovation for the benefit of the community.
entries.c753cff67a9fcaa89c8253fca02836403afee5c6: Approve Addendum 1 to the financial contribution agreement between the City of Montreal and MUTEK (CG25 0347), in order to increase by $100,000 the financial support for the implementation of the 2026 edition of the MUTEK Forum event, bringing the total amount of this financial support to $310,000.
entries.faecdcb8fb61fcda23b672075b5d213d34956195: MUTEK is a not-for-profit organization dedicated to the dissemination, promotion, production and development of emerging forms of digital creativity and electronic music. Its mandate is to act as a springboard for promoting and supporting creative artists and studios in their development and diffusion. The organization, created in 1996, also has six independent international branches: Barcelona, Mexico City, Buenos Aires, Santiago, Tokyo and Dubai.
entries.cbc6193e86f3cbe636475b6f1dd981d32108edf5: Provide $200,000 in financial support to Lauriers de la gastronomye québécoise and SCALE AI - Canadian Supercluster in Artificial Intelligence, for economic development projects / Approve draft conventions to this effect
entries.528c29e1639cbec7b93fc34021a37900804fd4bd: The Service du développement économique (SDÉ) contributes to the development of an innovative and creative economy, in particular by promoting the development of strategic niches and promising sectors of activity, as well as by supporting the growth and outreach of Montréal companies internationally. This objective is realized, among other things, by providing financial support to organizations for the organization of local and international business events in Montreal. The purpose of this file is to provide financial support to three organizations for the organization of business events that meet these objectives: $90,000 to the Lauriers de la gastronomye québécoise for the Festival de création gourmetaire MANGETOUT 2026; $110,000 to SCALE AI - Canadian Supergrappe en intelligence artificiale for the ALL IN 2026 event; $30,000 to Commerce international Québec for the R.I.S.E. and MercadOr 2027 event.
entries.838da021809df0af89e9f5026277a655c9937f37: To provide additional financial support of $24,000 to the Cité des Arts du Cirque (TOHU), in order to compensate for the impacts of construction projects during the 2026 edition of the Montreal Completely Cirque festival, which took place from July 2 to 12, 2026 / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.a2b5b7fb17b481ca37cb15e644088d764c6719e9: This summary is intended to provide additional financial support to Cité des arts du cirque (TOHU) for the production of the Montreal Completely Cirque festival. The aim is to offset the direct operational and financial impacts resulting from ongoing work in the Saint-Denis Street area as well as the new temporary signage that deprives this sensitive corridor of its pedestrian status for the summer of 2026. This support is in addition to the amount already allocated to the organization under the Festivals and Major Events Fund (FFEM) of the Department of Culture, Sports and Recreation (SCLS).
entries.36667d0981580ca716737048a590273bce55ce81: Provide $1,500,000 in financial support to Optech for the implementation of the Propulsion l'écosystem d'innovation photonique project in Montreal, for the period September 2026 to May 2029, as part of the Réflexe 3 agreement (Joint Economic Planning 2025-2029) with the Ministère de l'Économie, de l'Innovation et de l'Énergie / Approve draft convention to this effect
entries.7a281e0bbd69924ab4cab898f86e4cd8e64db66e: The Centre de technologie physique et photonique de Montréal (Optech) has been an OBNL since 2002. He is the manager of the Centre Collégial de transfer de Technologie (CCTT) in optical-photonics and quantum technologies, a mandate entrusted to him by Cégeps André- Laurendeau, de La Pocatière and John Abbott. Optech's mission is to help companies identify and develop industrial solutions to solve problems through processes or product development in optics, photonics and quantum technologies.
entries.42cc7d52e2f472c2905bcec7b356839acfa2dea7: Provide $125,000 in financial support to Culture Montréal, to support the implementation of its Action Plan 2026 / Approve the draft convention for this purpose
entries.f968eb86e58820759f49d0bcbc33698c291798ac: Founded in 2002, Culture Montréal is an independent, non-partisan and not-for-profit civic movement whose mission is to anchor culture at the heart of Montreal's development through activities of reflection, consultation and structured interventions towards the cultural community, decision-making and political bodies, civil society and citizens. The organization is recognized as the Conseil régional de la culture by the Ministère de la Culture et des Communications du Québec. Culture Montréal's main objectives are: To promote law, access and participation in culture for all Montrealers; To strengthen the role of culture in the development of the city, including by encouraging the involvement of professional cultural circles in the life of the community; To contribute to the positioning of Montréal as a cultural metropolis through the enhancement of its creativity, cultural diversity and national and international influence.
entries.40439df14d0dde4d48e1f7ea63576df408ab6584: Provide $1,174,326.52 in financial support to the Canadian Red Cross Society for the provision of assistance to persons affected by a two-year emergency response by the Montreal Fire Safety Service in the Montréal Agglomeration Territory, effective September 1, 2026 / Approve draft convention to this effect

It is essential to continue this assistance effective September 1, 2026, since it is considered to be an extension of the intervention of the SIM. The Red Cross is an integral part of the Canadian Red Cross Society, whose mission is to assist individuals, groups or communities living in emergency situations or disasters by providing humanitarian assistance.
entries.c201790797000039054cb19c4ac7264696160258: Provide $391,920.20 in financial support to Jeunesse au soleil for the provision of assistance to those affected by a two-year emergency response by the Service de sécurité feuille de Montréal, effective September 1, 2026 / Approve draft convention to this effect

entries.52f39823c31b469a6992faea58f13a160f77c864: The Réseau des grandes parcs de la Ville de Montréal (Network) is made up of 27 parks. The intensive use of the Network's territories, combined with the multiplicity of activities carried out, results in the proliferation of informal trails and entry points. However, there is a lack of identification, information and directional signs throughout the network's parks.
entries.f79b45171a0334ed8ad9e429640a2b1981ac903f: Grant an OTC contract to Mission Old Brewery, for professional support services for the path towards accommodation and housing of persons in a situation of homelessness in the area of camps on Notre-Dame Street, in the district of Mercier - Hochelaga-Maisonneuve - Total expenditure of $149,520, taxes included / Approve draft service agreement to this effect
entries.235ce4c4cfd289ee946df09b0da53f6ca304601c: Social issues affecting homeless people continue to grow in Montreal, resulting in a diversification of profiles, increased needs and increasing pressure on living environments. To respond to these challenges, the City of Montréal is focusing on a human approach that focuses on dignity, respect and support, in accordance with its Municipal Camp Management Protocol. The wasteland Notre-Dame, located in the Mercier-Hochelaga-Maisonneuve district, is particularly affected by the presence of camps, a phenomenon that has been growing rapidly over the past 18 months.
entries.aad1723a516e3cf6ef749b80363adafdd12dc873: Provide $195,000 in financial support to the Sustainable Mobility Agency for the implementation of the city centre parking sharing project, for the period August 2026 to August 2027 / Approve draft convention to this effect
entries.951e86f4e8d3c3f0bcbfa1f87cbf57bb6d834d74: The Montréal Sustainable Mobility Agency (MDA) is a paramunicipal company whose mission is to improve the quality of life and support economic vitality by putting its expertise at the service of the City of Montreal to facilitate the equitable sharing of space and accessibility of the city. It manages the street and off-street parking spaces entrusted to it, provides public space monitoring activities and federates mobility actors. In recent years, as part of the Montréal jointly program (Ville de Montréal), resulting from the Smart Cities Challenge (funded by the Government of Canada), the organization has received $6.05 million in financial support, including projects related to street border management, neighbourhood mobility and a mobility data management project.
entries.1ae979fd0896abd91ba478c5f290a2099ce9f8c9: Provide $1,000,000 in financial support to Médecins du Monde to support the implementation of the Rapid and Integrated Action Mechanism for People in Vulnerable Situations for the period from September 1, 2026 to March 31, 2028 / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.3039f29d3564ff2d61f40de0ae72005440d65158: The City of Montreal is observing an increase in situations of vulnerability, complex cohabitation and risk of harm in the public space, particularly affecting Aboriginal people and persons in situations of residential instability. Community organizations, Aboriginal partners and institutional partners note the need to strengthen coordination of interventions when high-risk situations are identified. Work with community partners has also highlighted the lack of a structured mechanism for collaborative assessment of critical situations and rapid mobilization of appropriate resources.
entries.bc9bdf33cd31589c44fe670135e6faa9158b713f: Providing $300,000 in financial support to Médecins du Monde, for the project Strengthening the security and capacity of Montreal community stakeholders in public space in a complex context of increased crises and violence, for the years 2026 and 2027 / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.cabdd6bbe37e0e31b6ec7c7843899d5cebfca3b9: The City of Montreal is seeing an increase in situations of vulnerability, complex cohabitation and risk of harm in the public space, particularly affecting indigenous people and persons in a situation of residential instability. Médecins du Monde (MdM) is an independent international organization that works with marginalized populations through health and advocacy programs aimed at universal access to care. For more than 30 years in Montréal, MdM has been deploying outreach interventions to vulnerable people.
entries.9d6f3737ad3f5acaa1c7db93668639eb8eb2fd1f: Award three contracts to Baulne inc., for a maintenance service of building mechanics - CVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) for various buildings in the City, for a period of 34 months, including two extension options of 12 months each - Total expenditure of $2,874,122.94 - Public tender 26,21391 (2 som.)
entries.16d042df37d287ecb7d9541d15f14a2155829a25: This file deals with the granting of three (3) lots for a service of maintenance of building mechanics - CVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) of thirty-nine (39) buildings in the City of Montreal, mainly fire stations. This contract is 34 months, from September 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, with two (2) extension options of twelve (12) months each. This activity is currently carried out by a private company and supervised by staff from the Buildings and Energy Operations Directorate, the Property Management and Planning Service (BMS).
entries.7379a5065f38cbeebc8aae3986d5711a89a08df2: Approve the proposed lease of 888 De Maisonneuve Commercial Trust, represented by Busac inc., for a ten-year term, effective February 1, 2027, a premises on the ground floor of the building located at 888 De Maisonneuve Boulevard East, in the borough of Ville-Marie, with an area of 12,684 square feet, for the purposes of the metro unit of the Station de quartier 50 of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, for a total rent of $4,836,594.23, including taxes
entries.e2797c3d21dd5adcfd726d140827dcec0d42471e: Since February 1, 2010, the Metro Unit of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal (SPVM) has occupied a premises with an area of 12,684 sq. ft. located on the ground floor of 888 Boulevard de Maisonneuve Est, in the borough of Ville-Marie. The lease currently in effect will expire on January 31, 2027. The SPVM has mandated the Service de la Stratégie immobilier et de l'habitation (SSIH) to negotiate a proposed lease to extend the occupation of the SPVM in its premises.
entries.96b7de640d1c985bc802f019b104355ad183704b: Approve the first agreement to amend the lease by which the City of Montreal and the Société d'habitation et de développement de Montréal wish to make an amendment to clause 4.5 - Monetary allocation of the lease made on September 25, 2025 (CG25 0593) / Authorize a revenue and expenditure budget of $22,500,000 net of rebates, in order to allow the use of the monetary allowance offered by the Société d'habitation et de développement de Montréal for the renovation work of the Chaussegros-de-Léry Building carried out by the Service de la gestion et de la planification des bâtiments, which are repayable by the Société d'habitation et de développement de Montréal
entries.aa767c803329e38f601dd2881d52a3b683df29a7: On September 25, 2025, the City of Montreal (City) agglomeration council approved a 23-year lease for the rental of the building at 303 Notre-Dame Street East owned by the Société d'habitation et de développement de Montréal (SHDM). Under this agreement, the City receives a monetary allowance of $22.5 million for work. However, clause 4.5 of the lease, relating to this allocation, provides that the work must be carried out by the landlord.
entries.b6585d643e0d66d1cf5851206e8bf18260bdfe6a: The mission of the City of Montreal's Water Service is to provide drinking water for the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater to protect public health, safety and the environment today and for future generations. The Jean-R.-Marcotte Wastewater Treatment Plant treats all of Montréal Island's sanitary waste water, as well as rainwater from unit systems. In order to improve the quality of treated water and reduce contamination of the St. Lawrence River, an ozone disinfection process will be integrated at the end of the existing treatment.
entries.c4be6ffe7816ec5cf95d3d39f8e92513262fa919: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to protect public health, ensure the safety of citizens and preserve the environment, today and for future generations. The Jean R.-Marcotte Wastewater Treatment Plant provides treatment for all wastewater on the Island of Montreal as well as rainwater from unit systems. In preparation for the commissioning of the future sludge treatment and recovery plant (UTVB) and the transfer of electrical power from the Jean R.-Marcotte Station, currently powered by the HydroQuébec Bout-de-l'île electrical station, the Major Projects Directorate (MDP) is to proceed with the construction of Phase II of the 315-25 kV electrical transformation station located at the Station site.
entries.778cc8287cb89485b68e7f034d166410f6f7b4f8: The City of Montreal's Water Service is responsible for ensuring the safe drinking water supply to the Montreal community, stormwater management and wastewater treatment, with a view to protecting public health, protecting citizens' safety and preserving the environment, both for today and for future generations. Jean-R.-Marcotte Wastewater Treatment Plant treats all of Montréal Island's wastewater, as well as stormwater from unit systems. In order to improve the quality of water treatment and reduce microbiological contamination of the St. Lawrence River, an ozone disinfection process will be added to existing facilities.
entries.9862551bc543ee4da24343268443088f018da60d: The City of Montreal Water Service is responsible for the distribution of drinking water, stormwater management and wastewater treatment in order to protect public health, safety and the environment. In 1980, Bizard Island's overpressure station was established as a strategic infrastructure for providing drinking water to the area, largely out-of-date or end-of-life facilities that no longer adequately meet current needs, particularly during peak periods and emergency situations.
entries.e7f42e9cb5b228c292c24fa9288140814e4b0271: Last April, the municipal administration of the City of Montreal (City) announced its intention to put in place the return of its employees according to a hybrid mode of work, three days per week on a face-to-face basis and two days in telework, starting September 14, 2026. Following this announcement, the Real Property Management and Planning Service (RPMS), as well as the Real Estate Strategy for Housing (SSIH), were involved in developing a management plan for administrative spaces to meet this new direction. The first phase of this plan consisted of extending leases of the building located at 80 Queen Street for five years, as well as that of the building located at 630 René-Lévesque Boulevard for a period of one year, to allow the implementation of the new management plan.
entries.94b85be4c5f5b0efd7425d8328a64da74e42fa41: Independent Insulating Respiratory Protection Devices (APRIA) are a primary part of the personal protective equipment and equipment for firefighters in the Montreal Fire Safety Service (SIM) and the Longueuil Fire Safety Service (SSIAL). They are essential to ensure the safety of personnel involved in contaminated atmospheres and to meet applicable health and safety standards, including those set out in the Occupational Health and Safety Regulations (S-2.1, r.13) and working methods established by National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards. At SIM, the last framework agreement for the acquisition of APRIA and the provision of parts and accessories for their maintenance was concluded in 2016 with Boivin & Gauvin Inc., for a 10-year period.
entries.41c93d594a6d17b56d99b2d660ac40a0f83d1058: The City of Montreal is continuing its interventions as part of the Griffintown urban project. This major project is coordinated by the Urban Planning and Mobility Service, which is the proponent and applicant service. The project is located south of the business centre in the Southwest District.
entries.af0c829319f8f2dbea6e83ca5343965b4343e7ae: Modify the funding source in an amount of $187,845, included in the total financial support of $581,845 provided to the Coopérative d'habitation Monde-Uni for the implementation of the Acadia project (CG26,0178), so that this amount is now funded through the Quebec Affordable Housing Program and is reimbursed by the Communauté métropolitaine de Montréal
entries.e53dc7371e97d315b1bd43e247428036c78d4736: The City of Montreal provided $581,845 in financial assistance to the Coopérative d'habitation Monde-Uni for the Acadia project, as part of the fund funded by contributions from the social component of the Regulations to improve the supply of affordable and family housing, including $187,845, representing 20% of the patient capital loan granted by the Société d'habitation du Québec (SHQ). At the time of this contribution, this portion of the funding was not recognized as an eligible expense under the Metropolitan Out-of-Market Housing Program of the Communauté métropolitaine de Montréal (CMM).
entries.155b1d8e6eb4aa70c20e074568566c02ed24afb1: Authorize payment of the invoice of Groupe CH inc., in the amount of $245,313.26, including taxes, for the rental of rooms at the Bell Centre, as well as catering, audiovisual production and event production services during the commemorative ceremony held on July 7, 2026 in tribute to Agent Mohamed Lamine Benredouane / Authorize an additional budget of $224,003.71, net taxes, for 2026, from the contingency budget
entries.d074d2342a90b707fe9dbbfc379190443e855eb2: The City of Montreal Police Service paid a final tribute to its brother, Agent Mohamed Lamine Benredouane (1992-2026), who died in the course of his duties on June 22.
entries.c4dd3da23ec410d843b63311a518bf5b67f1bf90: Authorize the receipt of a grant of $161,281 from the Ministry of Employment and Social Solidarity, to cover part of the costs inherent in holding ECO-RDV 2026 at the Bonsecours Market / Authorize an additional budget of expenditures equivalent to the corresponding additional income / Approve the draft agreement to this effect
entries.a334361d1c9782a2a38391f8d4e1eeb3755e8e12: ÉCO-RDV is an initiative of the City of Montreal that takes the form of an annual strategic networking event between public, parapublic and private donors and local, sustainable and innovative companies. The event aims to link concrete needs, upstream of projects, with Quebec solutions, in order to promote the realization of structuring projects, the conclusion of business agreements and the acceleration of the ecological transition. Relying on targeted networking activities as well as on upstream and downstream support, ÉCO-RDV generates concrete economic and environmental benefits by mobilizing an ecosystem of committed partners.
entries.3a2d581796bf28187c1144c62f07197d8285f231: Approve compliance with the objectives of the Plan d'aménagement et de développement de l'agglomeration de Montréal project of the Centre intégré universitaire de santé et de services sociaux de l'Est-de-l'Île-de-Montréal for the construction, expansion and redevelopment of the hospital complex at Hôpital Maisonneuve-Rosemont
entries.f1b05366b1318f62e526b0cdb66b51b7039e0716: On June 23, 2025, the Minister of Health sent a notice of government intervention (Notice) concerning the construction, expansion and redevelopment of the hospital complex at Maisonneuve-Rosemont Hospital (HMR). On August 28, 2025, the Conseil d'agglomeration de Montréal adopted resolution CG25 0511 approving the project's compliance with the objectives of the Plan d'aménagement et de développement de l'agglomeration de Montréal (Schema). (See Summary Decision 12588450111) In accordance with the provisions of section 151 of the Act respecting Planning and Urban Development (LAU), on June 22, 2026, the Ministère de la Santé et des Services sociaux (MSSS) served, by letter addressed to the chair of the Conseil d'agglomeration de Montréal (CIUSSS-EMTL), a new Notice to the conseil d'agglomeration about HMR. The project in question is under the responsibility of the Centre intégrée universitaire de santé et de services sociales de l ́Est-de-l ́Ile-Montréal (CIUSSS-EMTL).

entries.5fd7884d395fcfb126643e2081e112096a2fa518: The Regional Plan for Wetlands and Waters (PRMHH) of the Montréal agglomeration was developed to meet the requirements of the Act. The Act respecting the conservation of wetlands and water resources (LCGHH) gives responsibility to RCMs and agglomerations to design and implement the Regional Plan through the reform of the Act affirming the collective nature of water resources and aimed at strengthening their protection (Water Act). Draft HRMPH and amendment of the Scheme: In accordance with the Water Act, a draft HRMPH was submitted for analysis to the Ministry of Environment, Climate Change Control, Fauna and Parks (MELCCFP) in December 2023.
entries.d557af35e7dbc580fb797068bea7d08f86c58bb0: Authorize the receipt of a $9,000,000 grant from the Government of Quebec to ensure the continuation of the mission of the Musée de la Biosphere from 2026 to 2029 / Authorize an additional budget of expenditures equivalent to the corresponding additional income / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.40db6dfd46a85f91a42bbb29e913f4504461e8d5: In 2021, the Government of Canada, the Government of Quebec and the City of Montreal agreed to jointly fund the activities of the Biosphere, with an annual contribution of $3 million from each partner for five years, for a total investment of $45 million. The period covered by this agreement ended on March 31, 2026. Integrated into Space for Life in 2021, the Biosphere, the only museum in North America entirely dedicated to socio-ecological transition, has, over five years, renewed its mission, vision and all its museum experience and educational content.
entries.3b1bda45259a4567362a65d023bc00e692526c2e: Provide financial support to a total of $1,892,000 to eight related cities under the Accelerating Local Climate Transition Program to support the planning and implementation of projects from the Department of Municipal Affairs and Habitation's climate plans / Approve the Financial Grant Agreement between Montréal and Pointe-Claire, replacing the agreement approved by Resolution CG26-0382

entries.61fdce66f98ca3ce736e78b94ea1a48356f06537: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water to the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater by undertaking projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance.

entries.924139b3d2be16a49cf858bc4f230a6d23965562: The Council's standing committees are public advisory bodies established by the City Council and the City Council. In accordance with the Cities and Cities Act and the Charter of the City of Montreal, their mission is to inform the decision-making of those elected at the municipal and agglomeration levels and to encourage the participation of citizens in public interest debates. The Standing Committee on Finance and Administration tabled a report containing 33 recommendations to the Extraordinary Municipal Council on January 28, 2026 and the Extraordinary Town Council on January 29, 2026 in its document entitled "Public Study of Budget 2026 and IDP 2026-2035".

entries.b2f35622ba11f9c6539e3a6be39d41bac894d69d: The permanent committees of the council are public consultation bodies established by the municipal council and the city council. In accordance with the Cities and Towns Act and the Charter of the City of Montreal, their mission is to inform the decision-making of elected persons at the municipal and agglomeration levels and to encourage the participation of citizens in public interest debates. entries.f94b65dc875418f3145f8179412c7cfe5c45dd51: Each year, the Air Quality Monitoring Network (AQAN) publishes a report on its activities and the state of air quality. This assessment is part of its environmental monitoring mission and helps to ensure rigorous and transparent information. Montréal is Canada's pioneer in air quality monitoring.
entries.89e2094f9057150dbbde838de5cbbda9de4f468a: Deposit of the 2025 balance sheet of waste management in the Montréal agglomeration and reporting on the 2020-2025 Waste Management Master Plan
entries.86bbb9545a19386e72cae96bba3d6cccb87f693d: The Montreal Agglomeration Waste Management Master Plan 2020-2025 (MRMP), adopted by the Agglomeration Council on August 27, 2020, aims to achieve an ambitious goal of zero waste by 2030. It reflects the vision shared with the C40 Cities Climate Ledship Group by the Advancing Towards Zero Waste declaration signed by Montréal. Two main objectives for RPMB have been set: A 10% reduction in material generation over the life of the plan; A 70% diversion rate from disposal by 2025.
entries.ed2a502b5ca64d0da4492af60b585d5f1f0e5fcc: Annual report of the actions carried out in 2025 under Joint Economic Planning 2025-2029
entries.02676bfc8ec6352d20c423da3de9a30b329242e7: The Government of Quebec highlighted the distinctiveness of Montreal by ratifying in 2016 the Declaration on the Recognition of the Special Status of the Metropolis. The implementation of this recognition was expressed in particular by the signing of the Réflexe Montréal Framework Agreement, which included a commitment to develop joint economic planning and a commitment by the Government of Québec to contribute $150 million to the City of Montreal in support of its Economic Development Strategy 2018-2022. In 2023, the City of Montréal and the Government of Quebec renewed Joint Economic Planning for the period 2022-2025, aimed at establishing common directions and providing a framework for linking interventions in the economic development of the city.
entries.a724fef35de31dbfa7f96dcc33c0126083978d18: Tabling of the Montreal Ombudsman's 2025 Annual Report

entries.b5822f33eeaa9dbae58c601198740fe67ac10872: Under the Cities and Towns Act (s. 105), at the end of the fiscal year, the treasurer prepares the financial report for the fiscal year that has just ended and certifies its veracity. This report includes the municipality's financial statements and any other documents or information required by the Minister. Section 105.1 states that the treasurer must, at a meeting of the council, table the financial report and any other document prescribed by the Minister to be deposited.
entries.e11e384127c88ef72968b224c3905dc9f82fc0fa: Tabling of the City's Audit Committee Report to Councils on the Review of Financial Statements for 2025
entries.37a31094ec22a0748c27578219b4005550550224: The City of Montreal's audit committee is responsible for advising the City's various audit bodies, including on audit reports, financial statements, budget forecasts and the Auditor General's annual audit plan. The committee also acts as an intermediary between the City Council, the City Council and the Auditor General to ensure that the Auditor General can properly carry out her mandate and is informed of the concerns of the Boards. The Committee also monitors the implementation of action plans in response to recommendations from the Auditor General, the External Auditor and the Comptroller General.

(CM19 1203), thereby increasing the total amount of the contract to $4,118,154.43, including taxes

entries.24480a1508aee9e51c4db639a9a5f7017f68bc23: The mission of the Rolling Stock and Workshop Service (SMRA) is to ensure the availability and reliability of municipal vehicles and equipment, as well as to provide a variety of specialized services and products tailored to the needs of boroughs and central services, in an eco-responsible approach and in a safe environment. As part of its planning for the purchase of rolling stock for the years 2026-2027, SMRA has identified the need for the provision and installation of telescopic cranes equipped with tilting bins, to be installed on truck chassis provided by the City, which are required to effectively meet the operational requirements of the various boroughs.
entries.3742d9ae2a20ffaa5a043efb5f565417a91d5783: The central city, the borough of Montréal-Nord and the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville are collaborating in the creation of the Espace du Coeur-Nomade, which is scheduled to open in 2027. The Espace du Coeur-Nomade will be a mixed cultural place bringing together a library and a house of culture. Its programming will focus on cultural mediation and amateur artistic practice, while giving particular importance to the accompaniment of semi-professional artists, artist residency projects and various more intimate broadcasting projects.
entries.78e8a0248bcd592a027c93d70cc6921c19f3abb7: Contract with Construction N.R.C. inc., for the development of traffic lights and civil and electric mobility axes at the intersection of Alfred-Nobel and Hymus Boulevards in the Saint-Laurent District - Total expenditure of $1,092,852.55, including taxes - Public tender 516107 (4 som.)
entries.4f72578c8ddab6516c2853271a34ff5ae0a5659b: The Innovation and Travel Management Division (DIGD) of the City of Montreal's Urban Planning and Mobility Service (UMS) planned to upgrade traffic lights at Alfred-Nobel / Hymus intersection. At the same time, the development work related to the Metropolitan Express Network (MEN) structure, carried out by the Major Partner Projects Division – Implementation 1 (DGPPE1) of SUM, also required a redevelopment of this intersection (see attached location plan). In order to achieve the project in an optimal and cost-effective manner, it was decided to make a contract call through a specific contract, rather than entrusting the work to CDPQ Infra as part of contingent works on the MEN project, which would have resulted in higher costs.

entries.87f63c23c4ad395b8e6917664f153d9a0c7fac9d: The City of Montreal is responsible for 588 road and related structures: bridges, tunnels, walkways, retaining walls and noise barriers, located in 19 boroughs throughout the territory. entries.7d2d00ef744a2142aade820fa44bfddd78e9deed: Approve the extension of the lease by which the City leases to the Université du Québec for an additional period of five years, effective June 1, 2026, part of Lot 2,942,092 du cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montréal, on Henri-Julien Avenue, in the Plateau-Mont-Royal borough, with an area of 1,368 square metres, for vehicle parking purposes, for a total rent of $407,663.69, excluding taxes
entries.d49f44c08c564a8588f589ef47859781c901192b: The Université du Québec (UQ) has been using at least since 1999 the land of the City of Montreal (Ville), which is adjacent to 4750 Henri-Julien Avenue as a parking lot (51 spaces) for employees, teachers and other occupants of its building (4750 Henri-Julien Street) which houses, among others, the Conservatoire de musique et d'art dramatique de Montréal and the École nationale d'administration publique du réseau de l'UQ. The proposed lease maintains this transitional use of the site, being retained for the construction of social housing units. The UQ wishes to extend the lease for a period of five years and this file proposes an agreement to this effect.
entries.536f1aa8795c6fa4381b4c7f7af2c6b428e544de: Approve the draft addendum to the agreement between the City and the Sustainable Mobility Agency, in order to modify the terms of payment of management fees and the timing of annual transfers
entries.0c859a70fea591ad12433a5edf450983298a7abf: The Sustainable Mobility Agency is a paramunicipal organization that succeeded the Société en commandite Parking de Montréal (SCSM) on January 1, 2020 (CM19 1364). Its creation is the result of a reflection following the adoption of the Ville de Montréal Parking Policy in 2016 (CG16 0438). The Policy established parking management as a lever for sustainable mobility development and recommended in its priority actions the establishment of a municipal parking management body.
entries.582a3fc430b905efca3febefd1741ddda9fdbcbb: Approve the draft agreement with the Minister of the Environment, Climate Change Control, Wildlife and Parks for the City's authority to reinvest the amount of the grant made under the agreement signed on March 21, 2018, but not committed, for the rehabilitation of contaminated land in its territory (CM18 0525)
entries.c91d3fca8f93d5e331c3fad37318e18d835e08cc: In 2018, a $75 million agreement was reached between the Minister of Sustainable Development, Environment and Climate Change Control and the City of Montreal. This agreement resulted in the implementation of a program to rehabilitate land on Montréal territory facing contamination problems in soil and/or groundwater. The agreement was the subject of several amendments, including one fifth that increased the initial envelope by $6.4 million.
entries.c13dbfe50e17e57fc14173befa901af0b83aeaa3: Conclude a framework agreement with CGI Environnement inc. for the City's two-year sewer pipe repair work - Total expenditure of $695,074.07 including taxes - Public Call for Bids DRE-P2625-C (1 compliant sum)
entries.6140d5902f6edabbc8bedc3409c7059b849f76a3: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater by undertaking projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. Sewer repair work is identified with the Water Service following CCTV television inspections.
entries.7674945d666101321e126490529b3ed20c85804a: Conclude a framework agreement with Plasti-Bac Inc. for the supply and distribution of household waste collection tools for 2026 and 2027 - Estimated amount of agreements: $2,458,268.3 including taxes - Public Call for Bids 26-21362 (2 sum)
entries.453c24f21640292e8e7c5b51ae25842b16a1e800: Under the Metropolitan Waste Management Plan 2024-2030 (MRMP) of the Communauté métropolitaine de Montréal (CMM), approved by the Ministère de l'Environnement et de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs (MELCCFP), and coming into force on January 1, 2024, seven (7) directions and 42 measures were adopted, several of which must be implemented by local authorities, including the City of Montreal. Pursuant to section 53.24 of the Environmental Quality Act (RLRQ, c. Q-2), municipalities of the CMM are required to take the necessary steps to implement the MRMP in their territory.
entries.bbb84c5266fe96a1a5e4b56be50a262959287d57: Conclude a framework agreement with Orange Traffic Inc. for the provision of 24-month traffic light control units and cabinets (Lot 1), including a 12-month extension option - Estimated amount of agreements: $2,242,011.12 including taxes - Public Call for Bids 25-21121 (3 Som.)
entries.4bb9d1237b0d899f1accf05861fb91d98312a035: As part of its current practices, the City of Montreal maintains a strategic inventory of equipment parts in order to effectively meet its needs for maintaining, modernizing and installing traffic lights. The renewal and updating of this stock requires regular use of the market. To this end, the Innovation and Travel Management Division (GIMD) is publishing public tenders for framework agreements.
entries.58d404110aba3611ebe527793f78dac31bf146b8: Authorize the divestiture of four professional service contracts with Affleck de la Riva s.e.n.c., in favour of Studio Affleck de la Riva inc., to ensure continuity of services under the same conditions as the various contracts / Approve the draft contract transfer agreement for this purpose
entries.675b1e2d1901c8aedcbc7a40022f540de4dffcbc: The firm Affleck de la Riva s.e.n.c., has transferred to the firm Studio Affleck de la Riva inc. all its rights, titles and interests in the four (4) professional service contracts for the provision of professional services granted by the Property Management and Planning Service (SGPI) under the terms and conditions stipulated in the various agreements.
entries.ee719245f82e3df3c41c4ff72ac0d8e1cdbbba41: Exercising the option of the second 12-month extension / Authorize an additional expenditure of $141,618.36, including taxes, for parasitic management and control services in the living collections of Space for Life museums, under the contract awarded to Boisvert Gestion Parasite Inc. (CE23,1720), thus increasing the total contract amount to $566,473.40, including taxes
entries.83039ed726bb3c52daa5f7a041c357a039e5d803: The living collections of Space for Life, internationally recognized, constitute a scientific and cultural heritage that must be subject to rigorous preservation measures. In this context, the use of professional extermination service is essential in order to ensure control of populations of rodents and insect pests likely to compromise the integrity of these collections. On 8 November 2023, the Executive Committee authorized the award of a contract to Boisvert Gestion Parasitaire Inc. for parasitic control and management in accordance with the results of the public tender 23-20168.
entries.36976a972aa0fdb0bc44c072923e236e984e08f4: Declare the acquisition by expropriation or any other means, for street purposes, of five parcels of land located on Rue Jean-Talon Est, at the intersections of Boulevards Lacordaire and Langelier, in the arrondissement of Saint-Léonard / Authorize an expense of $1,520,000, plus applicable taxes, if any, for such acquisitions
entries.1b0f711ae9bc9731e4c2d2e885fa38b630b617cd: The Urban Planning and Mobility Service (SUM) commissioned the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service (SSIH) to acquire five parcels of land (the Building) near future metro stations Césira-Parisotto and Madeleine-Parent, in the borough of Saint-Léonard (the Arrondissement). The acquisition of the Immeuble is part of the project of redevelopment of Rue Jean-Talon Est, relating to the extension of the blue line of the metro whose range extends from 22nd Avenue to the traffic light located east of Boulevard Langelier.
entries.78896a68a441a3341e6aaf2d2ff666dd149f6912: The building known as the Pointe-à-Callière Museum of Archaeology and History located at 350 Place Royale, in the district of Ville-Marie was built in 1992. The project aims to completely repair the roof and replace the building's generator: The roof, over 29 years old, has recurrent infiltrations; The generator, which has been in service for more than 27 years, is at the end of its useful life. Works are required to ensure continuity of operations and protection of the building and archaeological remains.
entries.48564d7f1899f747c858c188a40ff9e881e3d50b: In 2026, the Road Infrastructure Service (SIRR) continued to implement the Complementary Planing and Coating Program (CPPR) and the Planing and Coating Program (PRCPR). The PCPR aims at rapidly improving the quality of the City of Montreal's administrative arterial network (RAAV). According to experts in the field (NOTE 1), the treatment of a pavement by planing and coating technique allows for an extension of its life for up to 15 years.
entries.33959536b2b07cc5e31ce272c1182f2410419041: Approve the lease amendment by which the City leases to the Agency of Sustainable Mobility, for a term of eight months, retroactive to May 1, 2026, an office space located at 1500 Rue des Carrières, as well as part of the land bearing lot number 2,537,833 du cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, in the borough of Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie, with a rental area of 785.62 square metres and 46 parking spaces, for a total rent of $122,330, excluding taxes
entries.af3f2a3ecbceab5fbee190bf987b4fe717b7d353: In December 2025, the Sustainable Mobility Agency (SMA) and the Urban Planning and Mobility Service (UMS) approached the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service (SSIH) to extend the AMD lease that expired on April 30, 2026. Among other things, the AMD's mission is to manage tariffed parking lots, both street and off-street, owned by the City of Montreal (City). In accordance with the original agreement, Parking Agents (ADS) occupy premises located at 1500 Rue des Carrières and have 46 parking spaces allocated in the performance of their duties.
entries.f3524555f88aadb66e0e1fa82ab03946b4700402: The Land Development Directorate of the Ahuntsic-Cartierville borough (L'Arrondissement) has a mandate to increase business relations and partnerships with economic actors. It collaborates in the animation of the community by participating in the activities of the partners and contributes financially to various projects that have an impact on the vitality and economic dynamism of the commercial and business sectors of the territory, including that of the Central District. The City owns land located at 50-150 Louvain Street West between Avenue de l'Esplanade and Boulevard Saint-Laurent, which is also known as L'Esplanade Louvain.
entries.17d0020f6a5c6cf02d44e08551f2780e0fe4e031: Contract to L'Archevêque et Rivest Ltd., for the construction of new greenhouses at the municipal nursery in L'Assomption, Lanaudière Region - Total expenditure of $1,313,760 including taxes - Public tender 26-6028 (3 sum)
entries.d8ca28f716be86a33cd4185f3cbcfff852da018c: The City of Montreal's municipal nursery, located in L-Assomption in the Lanaudière region, has been established since the early 2000s on a territory of about 70 hectares. It has approximately 64,000 trees at various stages of production and provides approximately 3,300 caliber trees each year to 10 arrondissements of the City from mid-April to mid-November. As part of its tree production, the municipal nursery uses two individual greenhouses for the production of seedlings, grafts and cuttings of trees.
entries.5fde19f88c0cf5bad866d3db546a0c206afefd36: Grant a contract to L.M.L. Landscapers and Frères inc., for the replacement of the synthetic grass flooring of the indoor soccer field at the Stade de Soccer de Montréal, located at 9235 Papineau Avenue, in the arrondissement of Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension - Total expenditure of $1,175,929.52, taxes included - Public tender 26-6037 (3 som.)
entries.3a1599a7bd84b15c4f9121f736145942dc77ca06: The Stade de Soccer de Montréal (SSM), located in the arrondissement of Villeray–Saint-Michel– Parc-Extension, provides citizens with soccer grounds as well as rooms that can accommodate various sporting activities and events. The indoor terrain of the complex is mainly dedicated to the practice of soccer, but also serves to hold major sporting events, including the International Gymnix. The synthetic turf coating of the indoor terrain, installed in 2015, has reached the end of its useful life.
entries.f7f0cb0b60b84b2df4f3a4d7aef86fa5e25692cb: On September 21, 2017, the Act to Increase the Autonomy and Powers of the City of Montreal, metropolis of Quebec came into force. Among other things, this Act gives the City certain powers related to the application of the Act respecting hours and days of admission to commercial establishments. Since that date, the municipal council may determine the hours of admission of customers to businesses in its territory at special events.
entries.ab9a5ad7e6095c130152d296a63d6aa4f1c23e6c: Increase the operating budget 2026 of the Urban Planning and Mobility Service, through environmental liability for contaminated soils, from an additional $388,954.57 net to fund an environmental and geotechnical characterization study as part of the preparation of plans and specifications for the Parc d'entreprises de la Pointe-Saint-Charles - Bonaventure project
entries.7e07a24b0deea604b842236c43ae249f7c8cfabb: The Bridge-Bonaventure sector is identified as a strategic planning area under the City of Montreal's (PUM) urban planning and mobility plan. The development of this vast territory is also guided by the Bridge-Bonaventure Sector Development Master Plan (BMDP), developed following an in-depth consultation process with the many partners in the sector and a public consultation led by the Office de consultation publique de Montréal (OCPM). As part of the transformation of this sector, the City supports the Société des Ponts Jacques-Cartier et Champlain Incorporated (PJCCI) in its project to refurbish the Bonaventure Highway on an urban boulevard, on a stretch between the former temporary bypass bridge of Île-des-Sœurs and the Victoria Bridge.
entries.d8fd6e7fe75dbbbf43ad0a719232696d4064ddc7: Increase the operating budget of Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie, through environmental liability for contaminated soils, from an additional $97,380.89 net of rebates for professional services related to the development of plans and specifications for gas mitigation measures required under the Père-Marquette redevelopment project and standards
entries.f6eb16adca6f4a550ce58ab86f62493bcf618b94: The Centre Père-Marquette, located at 1600 Rue de Drucourt, is located in the right-of-way of former quarry No. 30, whose exact limits are not precisely documented in this area. Because of this location, it is likely that the site will generate biogas. The redevelopment and upgrading project of the Centre Père-Marquette is currently in the planning stage.
entries.8b4485fa5d6fa1ed6e6b5565c26ef3308ac277ed: Remove from the public domain street lot 1,184,897 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, to pay it into the public domain as a local park, as part of the development project of Campbell Park West
entries.854d677e3e386f8eef961cb17f53495240dbb28c: VALIDATION Intervenor et sens de l'intervention Autres interveneur et sens de l'intervention Participants Reading: RESPONSIBLE DU DOSSIER Claudia VEGA File Analyst SUMMARY DECISION IDENTIFICATION File #:1267683003 Unit administrative Arrondissement Le Sud-Ouest , Direction de l'aménagement responsable : urbaine et du patrimoine , Division de l'urbanité Level of decision-making Proposed municipal council: Charte Montréale des Art. 22 b) develop parks, leisure facilities, rights and physical activity and quality sport, distributed responsibilities: equitably according to the evolving needs of living environments Project: - Subject: Request the municipal council to remove from the public domain rue la lot 1,184,897 from the Québec cadastre, electoral district of Montreal, and to pay it into the public domain as a local park, as part of the development project for Campbell Ouest Park.
entries.b057903869ec90399ba2fdd1fbcbf3be2d7c2565: Accept the delegation of the agglomeration council, pursuant to section 48 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (RLRQ, c. E-20.001) / Accept, pursuant to section 85 of the Charter of the City of Montréal, metropolis of Quebec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4), the offer of services of the borough of Saint-Laurent to assume responsibility for the design, coordination, management and implementation of work relating to the project of restoration and creation of wetlands and water resources in the wooded area of Parc Marcel-Laurin of the borough of Saint-Laurent
entries.5c309af7f4b7eec69aa9aecb05238417cfffd783: The forest of Parc Marcel-Laurin (hereinafter the Boisé) is a 15.44 hectare natural environment composed of two segments of streams as well as a network of marshes and swamps, which has been listed in the Directory of Protected Natural Environments and Contributing to Biodiversity in the Montréal Agglomeration since 2009. Financial Assistance for the Project In 2021, the borough of Saint-Laurent applied for a grant under Component 2 of the Program for the Restoration and Creation of Wetlands and Waterways (PRCMHH) of the Ministère de l'Environnement et de la Lutte contre les Changements Climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs (MELCCFP; summary 1207220010).
entries.c2c0b61a345653005cf90c0135ca0f34837cab10: Accept the offer of service of the borough of Ville-Marie to take over the design and execution of several maintenance and development work at Quartier des spectacles, in accordance with section 85 of the Charter of the City of Montréal, Métropole du Québec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4)
entries.1469354052ec9b8aaeb32618c569a99fb18c4e33: The Quartier des spectacles is experiencing strong traffic, resulting in an accelerated deterioration of infrastructure and equipment, requiring annual maintenance and improvement work. According to the City's Rules of Procedure on the delegation of the city council to the borough councils of certain powers relating to parks and facilities, as well as to the development and redevelopment of the public domain in the downtown area (08-056) the day-to-day maintenance of the Place des Festivals, the Promenade des Artistes, the Clark esplanade and the Parterre are entrusted to the council of the Borough of Ville-Marie. The work of maintaining and developing assets remains a responsibility of the city council.
entries.1657ea65424b3dbaafe4affd8bc97cbffca4cad4: Authorize the reallocation of the $5,000,000 balance from the Innovative Projects Reserve Fund, established under the agreement between the Sustainable Mobility Agency and the City, for the period 2020-2024 (CM19 1364), to be incorporated into the Operating Reserve Fund provided for in the current agreement between the two parties (CM25 1008) / Allowing the use of the balance as of the coming into force of this new agreement
entries.ef5028d5fe844396a71f5a29edc4dfd30956268f: The Agency for Sustainable Mobility (Agency) is a paramunicipal organization created by the City of Montreal to manage and develop the parking function in its territory. It succeeded the Société en commandite Parking de Montréal on January 1, 2020 and has, since its inception, played a key role in enforcing parking regulations, managing tariffed parking and operating certain mobility-related equipment. The first agreement between the Agency and the City covered the period from 2020 to 2024 (CM19 1364).
entries.0b662a7c5111c2601a487c1c575d43afc0b0bb16: Adopt a resolution for the regularization of the reserved track status on the Côte-Vertu-Sauvé axis in the borough of Saint-Laurent and for the modification of the function made to the reserved track on Maurice-Duplessis Boulevard in the borough of Montréal-Nord
entries.43c19d681f6d903f9c8e3da6187d8cc87f064fc5: For several years, the City of Montreal has been implementing various measures to encourage motorists to opt for active or collective transport. Among the measures put in place to achieve these objectives are the introduction of preferential measures for buses (MPBs). MPBs, including reserved bus lanes (which may be exclusive to buses or shared with other modes such as bicycles, taxis, carpooling, etc.), are interventions on the road network to promote public transportation (TC) and improve the reliability and punctuality of the service, thereby increasing the attractiveness and modality of this mode of transport.
entries.7eb6b24f320980ba2affc299c4a8e4b67d1cb11b: Ask Hydro-Québec to proceed with the design of the landfill of the aerial cable networks along Jean-Talon Street East, between 24th Avenue and Buies Street, in the borough of Saint-Léonard
entries.a9519e30e02f4ac22edb7a8bc139a26bff5246c8: The project to refurbish Rue Jean-Talon Est extends 3.5 km from 22nd Avenue to the first traffic light east of the intersection with Boulevard Langelier. It is secured to the extension of the Blue Line of the Metro (PLB) and located mainly in the territory of the borough of Saint-Léonard (SL), except for the section between 22nd and 24th Avenue in the arrondissement of Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc- Extension (VSMPE). It includes four intersections that will accommodate new metro stations: Pie-IX (Vertières), Viau (Mary-Two-Axe-Earley), Lacordaire (Césira-Parisotto) and Langelier (Madeleine-Parent).
entries.c8f7dc05f19e08363497bc125c4b06db59c5137f: Authorize transfers totalling $337,000 to two boroughs / Approve projects in these boroughs under the Borough Support Program for the revitalization of commercial sectors outside the territories of Commercial Development Corporations
entries.d1f4df429faab4dfe149f6852784fa62891667a5: Some 15,000 Montreal commercial establishments are currently operating outside the territories served by the Commercial Development Corporations (CDCs), but these sectors, which are less structured, have strong potential and require targeted support to support their development, including through studies and the implementation of appropriate initiatives. To address this issue, the City of Montréal has established a borough-specific program to intervene on commercial arteries not covered by the CDS.
entries.cb3014f2051961ca0a1fbbf219046d7c6cfd33e3: Extend until December 31, 2026, for a period of six months, the declaration of jurisdiction of the council of the City with respect to the exercise of all powers relating to rolling stock within the competence of the boroughs, with the exception of lease contracts of less than one year and lease agreements with operator or operator, in accordance with section 85.5 of the Charter of the City of Montréal, metropolis of Quebec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4)
entries.0d74b706e028380d8954c3b97d9c881845e87ba3: In order to improve its efficiency and provide the best possible services to the population at the lowest cost, the City of Montreal consolidated the rolling stock function on January 1, 2017 (CM16 1267). Valid for a three-year period, the repatriation of competency was renewed for the first time in 2019 (CM18 1310), then in December 2021 for a one-year period (CM21 1388), in December 2022 for a 30-month period (CM22 1485) and in June 2025 for a 12-month period (CM25 0795). The activities that have been grouped under the direction of the Rolling Stock and Workshops Service (SMRA) are: · Acquisition, maintenance and management of the fleet of vehicles and rolling equipment; · Management of all mechanical workshops in the territory; · Training of operators and operators of vehicles and rolling equipment (since 2022, repatriated to the borough cooperation and civic experience service – CM22 1490); · Fuel management.
entries.9999f578bb111ecb86d482878587c2c2b206af8f: Accepting the offer of services from the borough of Côte-des-Neiges– Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, in accordance with section 85 of the Charter of the City of Montreal, metropolis of Quebec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4), to take responsibility for the design and implementation of road repairs on the administrative arterial network of the City, with a view to holding the World Championships UCI Route 2026
entries.0cda32f5bd85b54c9dd05574eecfd1bd9113fbee: The Road Infrastructure Service (SIRR) is responsible for the repair and maintenance of the assets of the City of Montreal's arterial road network (RAAV), a jurisdiction under sections 87 (6) and 105 of the Charter of the City of Montréal.
entries.10832d21268a1c489ae67001a8d388d1a9d9b034: Increase the allocation of $72,777.50 net rebates to the Urban Planning and Mobility Service through environmental liability for contaminated soils, as well as the provision of $28,302.36 net rebates to the Space for Life Service, major parks and Mount Royal, to retain professional services required for the preparation and follow-up of a request for ministerial authorization and the preparation of plans and estimates related to remediation work in the context of the creation of compensatory aquatic habitat at Arthur-Therrien Park in Verdun District
entries.d6e03fdfe828b442c857424a902695492e48b564: Postponing capital budgets of unused districts in 2025 - municipal council component
entries.e75f5116811d5a708662a03579a8b310541f3058: The purpose of this file is to adopt an additional budget for IDP 2026-2035 from the carry-over of borough budgetary surpluses to December 31, 2025. The actual net expenditures of boroughs for 2025 amount to $130,059,000. A portrait of borough results as at December 31, 2025 is attached to this file.
entries.34d4f993c15a3a1495233dddba4804546958adb7: Close and remove from the public domain that part of Lot 2 652 264 of the cadastre du Québec, Registration Division of Montreal, covered by these Regulations
