entries.dc39ce4680337ef3837f4664034d2f57a1a226dd: As part of the project to extend the Montréal metro blue line, the Société de transport de Montréal (STM) must acquire certain buildings in order to build new edicles and other infrastructure essential to the network. As such, the STM plans to erect a refit station (Ouvrage) near the existing Jean-Brillant mechanical ventilation station. The latter, owned by the STM and serving the metro network, is located in the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce (Arrondissement) on the lot bearing number 2,944,810 of the cadastre du Québec.
entries.e35697c98d970c5a86c4beab96558e094f07ade0: Endorse any decision taken by the Conseil d'arrondissement de Verdun since the identification of Maison Nivard-De Saint-Dizier in Appendix D to the Charter of the City of Montréal, metropolis of Quebec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4), falling within the jurisdiction of the municipal council, that is, on June 6, 2024 / Accept the forthcoming offer of this council of arrondissement to assume responsibility for Maison Nivard-De Saint-Dizier, in accordance with section 85 of the Charter of the City of Montreal, metropolis of Québec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4)
entries.e074c8316d6b075196de5e9a5234e84bef054404: The Maison Nivard-De Saint-Dizier (MNSD), built in 1710, is one of the oldest French-inspired rural houses on the island of Montreal. It is located in the district of Verdun. In 2012, the House officially became a municipal museum institution with the mission, among other things, to preserve, document and disseminate the historical and archaeological heritage of the site.
entries.dffcde9863accbfe0c3286d118d6c1c593b0cab9: Adopt the policy of allocating, using and bailing out surplus from 2025, determining surplus management in the boroughs and adopting the allocation of surplus 2025 to specific files
entries.59b6e4600449e78b953fa3363acefadbf2e27e21: The consolidated financial report, audited by the City of Montreal, for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, will be tabled at the Assembly of the Municipal Council on June 15 (GDD # 1266254001) and the Council of Agglomeration on June 18 (GDD # 1266254002). This report shows that the City of Montréal has a total surplus of $256.6 million, consisting of a surplus of $263.8 million for the local component and a deficit of $7.1 million for the urban component. Surpluses or deficits, net of local activities, are owned by the City and the boroughs.
entries.626babbaea301f067c295601dcfae80826d3906d: Approve the 2026 Program of Activities of the City Council Standing Committees
entries.852e784866fef0d22c2a342a17fb117b7b4688b1: Under section 2 of the Standing Committees of the Municipal Council Regulations (06-009) , standing committees are required each year to prepare a program of activities that they submit to municipal council for approval. The programme of activities of each commission for the year 2026 is presented in Description . It should be noted that, in addition to the public consultation topics mentioned above, ad hoc mandates already given by decision-making bodies have been incorporated into programming in order to more accurately illustrate the current workload of the various standing committees.
entries.4a9c7e0a621568338bcd640e70b43c0f5e3458f0: Authorize a net allocation of $6,531,000 to the operating surplus for tax purposes for fiscal year 2025, and an amount of $21,617,000 for prior years from the expense account identified to be taxed or filled, in order to fund the effect arising from the application of new accounting standard SP 3160 - Public-Private Partnerships
entries.49681c1b1e2db6f0db83e5d0740d8ba6c00c4b1a: Notice of Motion and Tabling - Regulations for the Closure of a Part of the Street to the South West of 89th Avenue, between Eugène-Couvrette Street and Perras Boulevard, in the borough of Rivière-des-Prairies–Pointe-aux-Trembles, for transfer to riparian owners
entries.635e89c9b59f2acf54242f8b8c4094b716c38c09: Notice of Motion and Filing - Regulations authorizing a loan of $177,837,000 to finance the construction, repair and improvement of sports and aquatic equipment
entries.908ea3043ae848f055d9fcc2b12e680a12b63be2: Adoption - Regulations Amending the Small Residential Renovation Support Program Regulations (21-006)
entries.7e272bdaeccf78b7cac41a22dfc487026795e4dc: The RenoPlex Program focuses on stimulating the renovation and preservation of residential buildings from 1 to 5 housing units, with a focus on green transition work. The majority of lump sum grants have not been indexed since 2021, while renovation costs have increased significantly. The amounts are no longer sufficient to cover actual construction costs, thus reducing the incentive effect sought by the program.
entries.d2e2e6b9655f96d95dc6914f754acff596370227: Adoption - Regulations authorizing a loan of $29,000,000 to finance public domain development and redevelopment under the Namur-Hippodrome urban project
entries.6107698d7f79d47333a6d883c49de7b5b56480c4: In 2009, the Hippodrome de Montréal closed its doors after more than 100 years of horse riding activities. Since then, this vast land has attracted a lot of interest and has been the subject of several iterations of development. However, the challenges associated with its accessibility are so important that solutions need to be put in place in the expanded sector.
entries.44bd8b96d92751594f0ca2902706a60e83c53710: Adoption - Regulations Amending the City's Rules of Procedure on Delegation of Authority from City Council to District Councils (02-002)
entries.b3aa507a65bf8766c861da396a0fc270ea0da2ae: Bill 9 (PL 9), passed by the provincial government, entitled the Act respecting the strengthening of secularism in Quebec, was assented to on April 2, 2026. PL 9 enacts the Act favouring living together and providing accommodation for religious reasons (hereinafter "the Act"), which prohibits the use of a public highway or park for purposes of collective religious practice, unless a municipality authorizes, exceptionally and on a case-by-case basis, such use of its public domain to the extent that the conditions of this Act are met.
entries.d6f80079c3799f1ecbb7db9344667e97da90ce16: Rename "Kim-Yaroshevskaya Library" as the L'Île des Soeurs Library located at 260 Elgar Street in Verdun District
entries.6a518714324a799f2d2dd14a45dc64fe533f7a70: Following the death of Kim Yaroshevskaya on 12 January 2025, several people mobilized to assign his name to a public place. In January 2026, a citizens' request to rename the library in L'Île-des-Sœurs on behalf of Kim Yaroshevskaya was submitted to the Heritage Division and the Verdun District Office. The project received support from the borough office.
entries.23f51f75a84a69f565a2a5931f4da44f282cc78d: Appointment of Effie Giannou as alternate mayor for a six-month term
entries.c49dca83095a5d21331320f60b91c71f4548984b: Renewing Nicolas Demers-Stoddart's term as a member of the Jacques-Viger Committee for a second three-year term, beginning on 2 August 2026
entries.fec15bcb1c2c1854ef5c7462836f59eba9bda940: The Jacques-Viger Committee is the City of Montreal's advisory body on planning, urban planning, architecture, design and landscape architecture. It provides advice and comments and recommendations with a view to improving the quality of plans, projects and policies submitted to it, in accordance with the Jacques-Viger Committee Regulations (12-022), and gives its opinion to the City Council on any proposed amendments to the urban plan and any draft regulations adopted under section 89 (paragraphs 1, 2, 3 and 5) of the Charter of the City of Montréal.
entries.54bec6c429339d416d4f4a828f08d873777e46bd: Appoint Andréanne Moreau as an observer member of the Board of Directors of Pointe-à-Callière, Montréal Museum of Archaeology and History, for a two-year renewable term
entries.919fec6876cd24bd67471c468222dc5fb437cb77: It is necessary to appoint a new representative of the City of Montreal to the board of directors of the Pointe-à-Callière Museum. A usual delegation must be made in order to harmonize the file and name of the City observer within this cultural organization. Ms. Anne-Marie Sigouin, former city councillor in the borough of South West and president of the Commission on Culture, Heritage and Sport, had been an observer member on this board since 2018.
entries.04730c3e178f8b43edbcfa9113aafa84ec62cf97: Appoint Alexandre Devaux-Guizani as a member of the Commission on Transport and Public Works and Mercedez Plante as a member of the Commission on Economic and Urban Development and Housing
entries.6e12c3786ec52e3ce9d9abe11febb6d365f194d8: Renew the terms of office of Isabelle Dumas, Vice-President, Francyne Lord and Paul-André Linteau, members, as well as Luce Lafontaine, alternate member on the Advisory Committee in recognition, for a non-renewable period of three years, beginning June 15, 2026 / Appoint Elyse Lévesque currently an alternate member, as a member, for a non-renewable period of three years
entries.a22b10414df6a8c7b9a88ee8f52182f2bdcd0d81: The Advisory Committee on Recognition (ACR) is the City of Montreal's advisory body for recognition. Its mandate is to provide advice with a view to clarifying the City's decisions concerning proposed commemorative ceremonies, material commemoration, toponymy and identification regulations referred to in section 121 of the Québec Cultural Heritage Act. This committee was established by the adoption of its By-law 22-044 by the City Council on September 20, 2022.
entries.8f4bdcdd04554207c2f49ad50b167027195a99b1: Approve the appointment of Alain Dufort, as Director General of the City of Montreal, for a period of four years, effective August 17, 2026
entries.b9e2c90d2da9aa4ddf87a892c258ceac99dbecd8: Following the announcement of the departure of the current Director General, the Authority wishes to appoint a new Director General. Consequently, the Mayor recommends Mr. Alain Dufort as Director General of the City of Montreal.
entries.cdf54bfc07fb5c6627ad4ac4f9b8cbf2e859d220: Motion of the Official Opposition - Motion - For the introduction of a tax on vacant or under-used housing in order to put units back on the rental market
entries.bbee20bb3c96a9f253b67cbe66e21522d9519158: Conclude a framework agreement with Agence Gravel inc. for the provision of 9-millimetre practical ammunition for the training and maintenance of shooting skills of police officers of the City of Montreal Police Service, lasting 29 months, including a 12-month extension option - Estimated amount of the agreement: $2,068,860.15, taxes included - Public Call for Bids 26,21296 (3 sum)
entries.e0633bb7cfba17b1689bba8c41db663eedae0366: As part of the training program to maintain skills, the use of practice ammunition is essential to enable police officers to preserve and update their shooting skills. To this end, the Ministry of Public Safety (MSP) requires that Quebec police officers undergo an annual requalification for each of the weapons for which they are originally qualified. This obligation derives from the Police Act (P-13.1), which gives the Ministère de la Sécurité publique (MSP), specifically to the École nationale de police du Québec (ENPQ), the authority to establish standards and methods applicable to initial training as well as maintenance of competencies.
entries.ea97b74eb03edb81da455f2f02e4b0fa91e3f9fa: Exercise option of the second 12-month extension / Authorize an additional expenditure of $2,966,475.89, including taxes, for the supply and delivery of anionic and cationic polymers to the Jean-R.-Marcotte treatment plant under the contract awarded to SNF Canada Inc. (CG24 0348), thereby increasing the total contract amount to $8,880 010.31, including taxes
entries.0c509d233eef52041ffcd8bbbd640bcba8ea2145: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water to the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. Jean-R.-Marcotte de la Ville de Montréal (Station) is a waste water treatment plant designed to treat wastewater on the entire island of Montreal. This treatment requires the supply of chemicals called anionic polymers and cationic polymers.
entries.17b861f92a2b0db30cdd713270063a0dd2b63bfe: Exercising the option of the first 12-month extension / Authorize an additional $244,200, including taxes, for mail collection, sorting and distribution services for the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, as part of the framework agreement with Planete Courrier Inc. (CG24 0318), thus increasing the total amount of the agreement to $903,565.76, including taxes
entries.32a7fdfa32d167772fba77f9f6c4c4ced145a46e: The City of Montreal Police Service (SPVM) has approximately 150 units, including neighbourhood posts throughout the City of Montréal, which require courier services. In this context, the Physical Resources Division (DRM) of the SPVM, in collaboration with the City of Montreal Supply Service, conducted a public tender (24-20387) to conclude a new contract to ensure the continuity of internal and external mail collection, sorting and distribution service, as well as small parcels. The courier service provides for the delivery of internal mail within 24 hours between units, as well as an on-demand delivery service within a predetermined time frame, primarily used by the Courts Service.
entries.6a45fd67d8d93a021945bba4776c633013801699: Authorize an additional expenditure of $29,893.50, including taxes, for professional audit services under the contract awarded to Deloitte LLP (CG24 0727), increasing the total contract amount to $152,629.31, including taxes / Authorize an additional revenue and expense budget of $63,195, net
entries.bc8cd92ca2990830b585334ce57939cea25b7090: The initial contract entitled "Professional Services Contract to Deloitte LLP for the provision of audit reports under financial assistance programs, for a period of 24 months - Total expenditure of $122,735.81, including taxes - Public tender 24-20714 (1 sum)" was awarded to GC24 0727 dated December 19, 2024.
entries.3f04fa9b3a94e315af225145b9128eccfc561422: Exercising the option of the first five-month extension / Authorize an additional expenditure of $296,349.21, including taxes, for the rental of a compost sieveter and a tractor loader with operator at the Saint-Michel Environmental Complex under the contract awarded to Savaria Landscape Materials Ltd. (CG25 0369), thus increasing the total contract amount to $586,603.60, including taxes
entries.9f3445526866d4f3d60f04749378cf0814e61b17: The mission of the Environmental and Ecological Transition Service is to ensure the disposal and recovery of residual material collected in the territory of the City of Montreal. As part of its planning for the year 2026, the Environmental and Ecological Transition Service must exercise a 5-month extension option for the temporary rental of a compost sieve machine. Each year, the Environmental and Ecological Transition Service has the responsibility to receive and convert more than 12,500 t.m. of leaves recovered from parks and streets in the fall at the Saint-Michel Environmental Complex site.
entries.87468a7351a490c6026a1f9db4613950b40a32c7: Grant a contract to AON Parizeau inc., insurance brokers, for a $1,225,000 bond with La Compagnie d'Insurance Saint Paul, for a period of three years, for the Centre de traite des matières organiques de Montréal-Est, as operator of a residual organic material recovery facility - Total expenditure of $18,375, non-taxable / Approve compensation agreement to this effect
entries.1b740cbc13c78fb5c8b855dd3e7fd6eb974a2009: The Waste Management Master Plan (RMMP) 2020-2025 was adopted by the Agglomeration Council on 27 August 2020. It includes 49 actions focusing on source reduction, re-use, organic and recyclable materials, CRD residues (construction, renovation and demolition), participation stimulation and market intelligence. It focuses on best practices that respect the 3RV hierarchy (reduction, reuse, recycling, recovery).
entries.b88b4d8a50030500d9ca343a133d7e3c72657c11: Provide an over-the-counter contract to Info-Tech Research Group Inc. through its agreement with the Government Acquisition Centre for the acquisition of licences for access to information technology research and advisory services, for the period from July 31, 2026 to July 31, 2027 - Total expenditure of $126,995.62, including taxes
entries.47e882e5f20a77aa2ad1613aa4dce4bc07ce3dd6: Authorize an additional expenditure of $702,262.99, including taxes, as a quantity variation budget, for digital solution development services under the Master Agreement with CGI Management and Informatics Consultants Inc. (CG25 0114), increasing the total amount of the agreement to $6,298,929.81, including taxes
entries.1c8a641c2fc92856f3da34f3e503ca89dae0bb36: Provide six contracts to Axia Services and Garda Safety Group n.e.c., for child care services and all related services for various City facilities (lots 1 to 6), for a 36-month period, including two 12-month extension options - Total expenditure of $7,072,093.44, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 26,21331 (4 som.)
entries.91ded0bf1c19150ce594dd3583d30f4d65ee1e74: The present case concerns the granting of several security services contracts for various municipal facilities. These contracts, with the possibility of extension, last three years to ensure the safety of persons, the protection of property and the maintenance of order in the buildings concerned. Services include guarding and related interventions, such as patrols, depending on the specifics of each site.
entries.88574a4e9669634391ef14f6cb79deffa535671e: Exercising the option of the second 12-month extension and authorizing an additional expenditure of $934,221.31, including taxes, for the supply and transportation of container residuals for the St. Lawrence Ecocentre under the contract awarded to Excavations Vidolo Ltd. (CG23 0650) and transferred to GFL Environmental Inc. (CG25 0493), thereby increasing the total contract amount to $3,173,060.07, including taxes
entries.2250424e25d6b6b364ce685b7107bd7e3fa13424: Under section 16 and subsection 6 of section 19 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (RRLQ, chapter E - 20.001 - Act 75), disposal and recovery of residual materials are responsibilities of agglomeration. Under section 17 of the Act, the central municipality may act with respect to residual materials constituting the responsibilities of agglomeration not only in its territory but also in that of any other related municipality. The Environmental and Ecological Transition Service (SETÉ) assumes this responsibility for the agglomeration.
entries.41b0fa031696e516a7481b37e831328b3b7057bd: As part of the operations of the six (6) drinking water production plants as well as reservoirs under the Directorate of Drinking Water (DEP), as well as the Jean-R.-Marcotte (DEU) water treatment plant of the Service de l'eau, eleven (11) framework agreements were granted by the conurbation council at the session of October 21, 2024 (CG24 0576). The purpose of these agreements was to supply and deliver chemicals used at the drinking water production plants of Atwater, Charles-J.-Des Baillets, Pointe-Claire, Pierrefonds, Lachine and Dorval, as well as at the Jean-R.-Marcotte sewage treatment plant. They cover a period of 24 to 26 months depending on the lot, from January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2026, with an option of extension for 12 months.
entries.2b4dbad4bea73f25ebc31d24094651b33614f123: Conclude a framework agreement with Mabarex Inc., an exclusive supplier, for the supply and delivery of 20 Kilowatt UV lamps used on Charles-J.-Des Baillets and Atwater plants' ultraviolet reactors for drinking water treatment for 36 months including two 12-month extension options - Estimated amount of the agreement: $1,831,254.25, including taxes - Notice of Intent 26-00007
entries.241ca4da50da27639c135fcff044ece6f5368d66: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater, ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. The Ville de Montréal Drinking Water Directorate is responsible for the production and distribution of drinking water. Atwater and Charles-J.-Des Baillets plants use ultraviolet treatment in their drinking water production process to ensure disinfection of water.
entries.7e4eee1566fd9cdf3152463e543b8447fe3c1a86: Conclude two framework agreements with Béton Provincial Ltd. and Amrize Canada Inc. for the supply and delivery of premixed concrete and unremoved embankment, for a period of 24 months, including three extension options of 12 months each - Estimated amount of agreements: $4,659,350.38 including taxes - Call for Bids 26-21360 (2 som.)
entries.e290ca9e84fd5f3592d19647199a914661b37abd: The purpose of this file is to conclude two framework agreements for the supply and delivery on demand of premixed concrete and unremoved embankment, mainly for road works under management. These framework agreements will be made available to all business units in the City of Montreal. In June 2025, contracts for the supply and delivery on request of premixed concrete and unremoved embankment were awarded, in accordance with public tender documents 25-20902, to the lowest compliant bidders, namely Béton Provincial ltée and Amrize Canada, for an estimated total amount of $2,281,104.14, including taxes.
entries.bdef0a67e22c4e48e42011bc704246cd5108a64b: Award a contract to Electro Performance G.L. Inc., for the design and management services of a complete temporary power grid, as part of the World Championships Route UCI Montréal 2026, for a period of one month - Total expenditure of $489,839.49, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 26-21382 (1 sum)
entries.b1e57baf313e38350969754784e7a96a32d41c44: As part of the preparations related to the holding of the UCI Route Montréal 2026 World Championships and the Grand Prix Cycliste de Montréal (GPCM), the City of Montreal must ensure the deployment of all electrical installations necessary to guarantee the deployment of all connections in order to ensure the smooth running of this major international sporting event. The GPCM will take place on September 13, 2026 and this event uses one of the routes of the UCI Route Montréal 2026 World Championships in addition to the starting and finishing site and the fans area. The UCI Route Montréal 2026 World Championships will be held on the territory of the City of Montreal from September 19 to 27, 2026 and will bring together athletes, technical teams and officials from many countries.
entries.b1f2d0115efbb0b98bd636654296965e3657469e: Conclude five Master Agreements with T.M.S. Masters of Trucks Ltd., for the City's diesel engine repair and heavy-duty truck transmission services (lots 1 to 5), for a 12-month term, including a 12-month extension option - Estimated amount of agreements: $3,531,470.99, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 25,21243 (1 sum)
entries.490f716ea3ff3cc5ce5232f2bca4d5f7d2474837: Authorize the divestiture of rights and obligations in framework agreements with Trois Diamants Autos (1987) Ltd. (CG24 0508 and CG26 0114) to Olivier Mascouche Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram Inc., for the supply of genuine Chrysler brand vehicle parts and light-duty vehicle maintenance and repair services in the City
entries.5875fbfe6ced106675b1a2cf461d09778f72a7b2: The mission of the Rolling Stock and Workshop Service (SMRA) is to ensure the availability and reliability of vehicles and equipment, as well as to provide a variety of specialized services and products tailored to the needs of boroughs and central services in an environmentally responsible and safe environment. As part of the maintenance of the City's vehicle fleet through its workshops, some replacement parts are not available on the generalist vehicle parts retailer market. These so-called genuine parts are only available through dealers associated with their brands.
entries.d94a13a756711d9749f7e36ca7569ee926ff4bec: Grant a contract to Les Entreprises Michaudville inc., for the work of main and secondary water pipes, sewers, roads, massifs of the Commission des services électriques de Montréal and Bell Canada on De Champlain Street, between Rue Sainte-Catherine Est and Boulevard René-Lévesque, in the borough of Ville-Marie - Total expenditure of $14,417,925.33, including taxes - Public tender DRE-P2605-200354-C (7 som.)
entries.5c7186548dfb40cfebacaf41d43072cd5d1d2713: The City of Montreal's Water Service (WS) is responsible for providing drinking water to the Montréal community, managing stormwater and remediating wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protecting the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate (WSD) is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater, carrying out projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. This project is part of the recovery of municipal infrastructure assets to ensure the reliability of the main water system.
entries.087760add07a3467cb8ba6ee9997b9b34ff9c111: Grant a contract to Fer-Pal construction ltd (Technologies Sans-Tranchée CoreAqua), for the rehabilitation of 600 mm grey cast iron water pipe along Highway 15 North and Atwater ramp in the Southwest District - Total expenditure of $741,026.71, taxes included - Public tender DRE-P2616-201370-C (3 som.)
entries.019c465648847ed8da0f0587a2e3b4b6c416e34b: The City of Montreal's Water Service (WS) mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate (WSD) is responsible for delivering quality drinking water and collecting wastewater by undertaking projects to upgrade and develop network assets while ensuring their operation and maintenance. In this context, a section of the 600 mm grey cast iron pipe along Highway 15 north west of Atwater Avenue in the South West District was omitted during the reconstruction of the Samuel-de-Champlain Bridge and the realignment of Highway 15.
entries.e66b15b35d1fee09479b75abcd8eaa4669c2d488: Award a contract to Tessier Recréo-Parc inc., for the modernization of the Salamandre playground at Mount Royal Park - Total expenditure of $959,946.14, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 24-6159 (5 Som.)
entries.c4169db8ad856b85cd3d46a6edc92d5a9d5490e3: The Salamandre playground at Mount Royal Park is a popular area for families, children and visitors on a daily basis. However, it is currently in an advanced state of deterioration due to its intensive use and aging of infrastructure: ground protection surfaces are worn out and decomposed, which compromises the safety of users; ropes on bridges and structures are damaged, with steel cables appearing; game modules have waste surfaces, missing climbing sockets and equipment removed; the playground is incomplete. Furthermore, despite the good practices applied during its creation, several modules remain inaccessible to children with special needs, contrary to the principles of inclusion and universal accessibility.
entries.c836929a29638970b554fa5cc19fb7dbca906e68: To authorize an additional expenditure of $229,950, including taxes, as a contingency budget, to cover part of the additional work and time required by significant water damage under the contract awarded to Construction Savco Inc. for the restoration and renovation of Smith House at Mount Royal Park (CG24,0720), thereby increasing the contract amount to $3,593,912.41, including taxes
entries.1ec813a1851d908c5a9e824e4db1aecb650a1c63: The Service de l'Espace pour la vie, des grands parcs et du Mont-Royal (SEPVGPMR) implemented a project to restore and renovate Smith House at 1260 Remembrance Road in Mount Royal Park on the heritage site of the same name. This project is part of the broad objectives of the Mont-Royal Protection and Development Plan (MPMVMR) adopted in 2009, the Mont-Royal Heritage Site Conservation Plan (Ministry of Culture and Communications, 2018), as well as the Plan nature et sports - Montréal des Sommets, which aims, among other things, to protect the identity components of Mount Royal. The construction site began on February 3, 2025 and was scheduled to end on February 3, 2026 (365 days contractual deadline).
entries.7db5bc72376b0b142964de61a798518bb68d1864: To authorize an additional expenditure of $12,144,522.14, including taxes, as a contingency budget, for the rehabilitation of a water line in the rue de la Cathédrale, from Saint-Jacques Street to McTavish Reservoir, in the arrondissement of Ville-Marie, under the contract awarded to Pomerleau Inc. (CG25 0653), thereby increasing the total amount of the contract to $49,551,168.30, including taxes
entries.f820e917a18d3a44802f4a744e739be70a0bc22e: The City of Montreal's Water Service (WS) is responsible for providing drinking water to the Montréal community, managing stormwater and cleaning wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protecting the environment today and for future generations. The management of water systems (WS) is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater by carrying out projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. In 2019, the WS conducted the auscultation of a main water line located below Cathedral Street between Rue Saint-Jacques and McTavish Reservoir.
entries.8b03cf964bcfdaa5173d3a94aa48da973d43a157: Contract with Constructions Concreate Ltd., for the steel and electricity structure work on the Mount Royal Cross - Total expenditure of $3,769,140.63 including taxes - Public Call for Bids 517301 (1 sum)
entries.d29bf3f1985a706746824384ede43ef0c9fcb653: The cross and its illumination are an artistic and commemorative heritage property, emblematic of the Mount Royal Heritage Site and of the metropolis. The maintenance of all its components is essential. To this end, during the transfer of the cross by the Société Saint-Jean-Baptiste in 1929, the City committed itself "to keep this monument alive not only in existence but also in good light." Protection and presentation of this component of the Mont-Royal Heritage Site is also under the authority of the Cultural Heritage Act.
entries.8fd88171239f6d0417b341cba9a3f7579c3d680d: Conclude a framework agreement with AFI by Edgenda Inc. for professional services in the design and dissemination of a 24-month business analysis training course (Lot 3), including a 24-month extension option - Estimated amount of the agreement: $127,737.23, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 26-21306 (1 Sum.)
entries.d0de5b53764dcfc8e97024d53d5527b7444a78cc: Grant a contract of agreement to Nature Action Québec Inc., for professional and technical services for the implementation of consultation mechanisms and the planned humanized landscape conservation plan of Île-Bizard, for a period of two years - Total expenditure of $190,612, taxes not applicable / Approve draft service agreement to this effect
entries.b8bd21e8e067aa6641d4398ff3cc2ad4f162bf89: On September 2, 2021, by ministerial order, the Ministère de l'Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs (MELCCFP) granted the City of Montreal a protection status for the western portion of Bizard Island, which is designated as the proposed Humanized Landscape of L'Île-Bizard. In 2022, an administrative agreement was concluded with MELCCFP, calling on the City to ensure the protection and management of this territory, as well as the implementation of the humanized landscape conservation plan of Bizard Island. In September 2025, MELCCFP provided $510,000 in funding to the City for fiscal years 2025-2026 to 2027-2028, to support activities related to the planned humanized landscape of Bizard Island.
entries.179f8660aeb731c9c4bd24b301775b28985349db: Authorize the divestiture of two framework agreements for professional services concluded with Affleck de la Riva s.e.n.c., in favour of Studio Affleck de la Riva inc., to ensure continuity of services under the same conditions as the various framework agreements / Approve the draft agreement for the transfer of contracts for this purpose
entries.b451c1c482d6ffc1b31968f543068ebc4ca62352: On 21 December 2023, following the public tender 23-20147, the Conseil d'Agglomeration decided to enter into two (2) framework agreements with the consortium formed by Affleck de la Riva architectes s.e.n.c., DWB Consultants and EFEL Consultants inc. (lots 1 and 2) which undertakes to provide to the City, upon request, professional services in architecture and engineering for various projects of the Real Property Project Management Directorate ("DGPI"). The firm Affleck de la Riva s.e.n.c., transferred to Studio Affleck de la Riva inc., all its rights, titles and interests in both (2) framework agreements for the provision of professional services under the terms and conditions stipulated in the different agreements.
entries.a32fb1c6375f097374988b328af7770b4407c67d: Award a contract to Rümker (9276-2723 Québec inc.), for the professional design services of the "Poptopia" exhibition at the Biosphere - Total expenditure of $1,078,051.90 - Public tender 26-21347 (5 som.)
entries.ca2c57d6a12a3609b9e66c581b2ee0aa131fc6f4: Starting in December 2027, the Biosphere wishes to offer an immersive thematic exhibition to the general public. "Poptopia. Ecological utopias in popular culture" (work title) will highlight positive ecological alternatives imagined by cinema, television, literature, cartoons and video and social games. Indeed, for several decades, popular culture has been exploring utopian visions of nature-friendly lifestyles.
entries.95d8a96bcc15258d0a12a023e622c39203eb6c37: To conclude a framework agreement with Société Conseil Groupe LGS, for professional services implementing the Oracle HCM Cloud solution, lasting 24 months, including two extension options of 12 months each - Estimated amount of the agreement: $2,808,643.79 including taxes - Public Call for Bids 26,21312 (3 sum)
entries.9411ad1f891da481f8af3bc5c3f1bdc0c1cec12d: Contract to 4455878 Canada inc. (Bruser), for the professional auscultation services of 22 main sewer pumping stations, for a period of 12 months - Total expenditure of $1,052,017.94, including taxes - Public tender 26-21319 (2 som.)
entries.f9b485949ff6a25a7d27d78998310d9bc3a76b6b: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water to the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. The City of Montreal's sewer system is an infrastructure essential for protecting public health, preserving the environment and maintaining the continuity of municipal services. This complex network is based on linear infrastructures (local drivers and collectors) and point-based infrastructure, among which sewage pumping stations play an important role in ensuring that wastewater and stormwater are collected and discharged in areas where gravitational discharge is insufficient.
entries.7311ed056d959c8a35d08b512936df752054d0f8: Approve the agreement between the City of Montreal-East and the City of Montreal to delegate the development of a multifunctional track on Sherbrooke Street between Joseph-Versailles Boulevard and Durocher Avenue, in the City of Montréal-East - Total expenditure of $1,608,828, net of non-taxable rebate
entries.97d5939cf8dfc148364a860bd3d1bf7940249266: The current and planned cycling network of the Île de Montréal, identified in the Transport Plan (Pan-Montréal bike network), falls within the competence of the Conseil d'Agglomeration de Montréal as an object of collective interest (Decree of Agglomeration 1229-2005). Aware that the Ville de Montréal-Est wishes to develop a cycle axis identified in the 2019 Bike Plan, approved by the Conseil d'Agglomeration, and thus falls under its jurisdiction, the Ville de Montréal-Est has offered to carry out the work there pursuant to section 572.1 of the Act respecting Cities and Cities. This section provides that any municipality may enter into an agreement with another municipality for the purpose of carrying out jointly, inter alia, the performance of works or the solicitation of tenders for the award of contracts.
entries.e746afdb2581e44218a7ef74c53f6d7e6d2db4e1: Approve the draft exhibition agreement between the City of Montreal and Studio Supply and Demand Inc., for the holding of the exhibition entitled "The Sensory Odyssey" from December 5, 2026 to October 11, 2027 at the Biosphere / Authorize a total expenditure of $474,271.88, including taxes, to this effect
entries.de903311cfd6c38a743d0a53e3fe02a533bda615: Since joining Espace pour la vie in 2021, the Biosphere has renewed its museum approach to offer dynamic programming of exhibitions, educational activities and events at the intersection of science, arts and communities. It is now a place for dialogue dedicated to socio-ecological transition and joins almost 150,000 visitors every year. In this continuity, the Biosphere wishes to present to the general public a large-scale exhibition inaugurated for the holiday period 2026 and deployed over a period of one year.
entries.b6069c728f9266a0edba6502c1adc0df7f2cbfd9: To enter into a framework agreement with the Government Acquisition Centre to adhere to the consolidation of purchases of switch and network products goods and services, for the maintenance and modernization of network infrastructure, lasting 24 months - Estimated amount of the agreement: $12,014,887.50, including taxes
entries.38b273c06a868cc5072ebf41961d1acf9a76d5ce: Order the acquisition by expropriation or other means of three parcels of land corresponding to three parts of Lot 2,090,312 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, an area of 4952.5 square metres, located southwest of Dalton Road East southeast of Cavendish Boulevard, in the City of Mont-Royal, for street purposes for the extension of Cavendish Boulevard / Authorize an expense of $3,900,000, plus applicable taxes, if any, for that acquisition
entries.485b40a28b34ca12a61e43b6614c41a82c850fcf: The Urban Planning and Mobility Service (UMS) commissioned the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service (HSIS) to acquire three parcels of land corresponding to 3 parts of Lot 2,090,312 of the Quebec cadastre, located southwest of Dalton Road and southeast of Cavendish Boulevard, in the City of Mont-Royal (the Building). The acquisition of the Building is part of the implementation of the Cavendish Boulevard Extension Project, which constitutes a structural intervention integrated with the detailed planning of the Namur-De la Savane area. A notice of reserve for public use was published in the Montreal Land Book under registration number 27,507,984 on August 24, 2022 for a period of two years.
entries.4b77fb5dbe8a5d7ff04cc08af4517b4052254cd4: Approve the draft act under which the City of Montreal sells to the Société de transport de Montréal, for the purpose of expanding the entrance of the Place-Saint-Henri metro station, the volumetric lot 6,620,729 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, an area of 364.3 square metres, located at the corner of Rue Saint-Jacques Ouest, Place Saint-Henri and rue Notre-Dame Ouest, in the northern section of Place Saint-Henri, in the borough of South-West, for the sum of $495,150, plus applicable taxes, if any / Close and remove from the public domain Lot 6,620,729 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montréal
entries.65ba77a76eeb2361fc7ec26c77586cdef2cb0672: The Société de transport de Montréal (STM) has requested the City of Montreal (City) through the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service (SSIH) to acquire the volumetric lot known and designated as Lot 6,620,729 of the cadastre du Québec (Building). The Building is located at the corner of Rue Saint-Jacques Ouest, Place Saint- Henri and rue Notre-Dame Ouest, in the northern section of Place Saint-Henri, within the arrondissement du Sud-Ouest. Since 2009, the STM has had a universal accessibility policy aimed at improving access to its services for all its clients.
entries.6b760458d44661a1890d26f566574d946dfdf3c2: Approve the draft Act by which the City of Montreal sells to the Société de transport de Montréal lots 6,575,502, 6,575,506 and 1,185,632 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, and creates easements of passage, charge limitation and non-construction on lot 6,575,503 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, all for the sum of $257,425, plus applicable taxes, in order to allow the repair and expansion of the mechanical ventilation post Riel located in the borough of Verdun / Close and remove from the public domain lots 6,575,502, 6,575,506, 1,185,632 and 6,575,503 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montréal
entries.4b8b2818c6c3aa0a7196205683166464725eb711: Approve the draft second addendum to the tripartite promise by which the City of Montreal sells to 9536-1135 Québec inc. and Helpful Développement, the building known as l'Îlot Voyageur Sud, consisting of lots 3,523,567 and 3,523,568 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montréal, with an area of 7,062 square metres with a building above erect, located at 505, boulevard De Maisonneuve Est, in the arrondissement of Ville-Marie, for the sum of $20,000,000 payable with interest, plus applicable taxes, if any, according to the terms and conditions stipulated in the addendum
entries.7f116422959db6bd6970e5fac1bf7d21d0653918: Authorize the transfer of $114,975, including taxes, from incidental expenses to contingent expenditures, for additional work required under the lease agreement with 9227-9702 Québec Inc. (CG25 0120 and CG25 0368), thus increasing the maximum contract expenditure to $2,345,490, including taxes
entries.ae8e8d605091b48292772515fc9c55d36ae13fc2: Since February 22, 2020, the Montreal Police Service (SPVM) Neighbourhood 21 (PDQ 21) has occupied a 10,837.50 sq. ft. space located at 1669 Berri Street in Montreal, whose lease will expire on November 30, 2031. On March 20, 2025, the City Council approved the 2nd lease agreement that recommended the expansion of the SPVM leased premises (3,892 sq. ft.). Under the lease, the development work is carried out by the lessor, according to a turnkey project, but reimbursed by the City for a maximum amount of $1,600,000, plus impacts ($160,000) and contingencies ($340,000) totalling $2,391,480.00, including taxes.
entries.1f691642982dfe2d575b5017e1a37e1005e86399: Approve the first lease amendment agreement by which the City of Montreal leases Development Vue Phase IV inc., an office space located at 7409 Mountain Street Sight, in the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, with a surface area of 9,000 square feet, for the purposes of Neighbourhood Station 26 of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, for a term of 12 years and 22 days, beginning on March 10, 2026 - The total rent is $5,807,275.72, including taxes
entries.4bfadafcd859e14cb75cd8b68a3170aa95f2e29a: Since March 10, 2017, the Montreal Police Service's (SPVM) Neighbourhood Station 26 (PDQ 26) has occupied a 9,000 sq. ft. space located at 7409 Mountain Sight in Montréal, which has expired since March 9, 2026. The SPVM mandated the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service (SSIH) to renew the lease and carry out some work within the PDQ in order to expand police locker rooms. SSIH was not able to obtain approval of the lease in the required time, as the orientation and diligent checks required by each party on file were longer than expected.
entries.54e4513bbcb06b0482afdbc581e8d1ba6b5fd364: Approve the proposed space loan by the City of Montreal to La Société pour la prévention de la cruelité contre les animaux (Canadienne), for a period of two years, effective July 1, 2026, a premises on the ground floor of the building located at 7487 18th Avenue, in the arrondissement of Villeray–Saint-Michel– Parc-Extension, with a total area of 3,955 square feet, for storage of animal food and equipment related to community activities - The amount of the real estate subsidy is estimated at $94,920
entries.6f86581a0f4c83d00f6f189f36ce8df99c8549c4: On August 30, 2023, the City of Montreal (City) exercised its right of preemption to acquire the building located at 7335, rue du Mile End. On the date of acquisition, two leases were in effect, including that of 3/4 oz Inc. (Company). In July 2025 a new lease was entered into with the Company for a period of one year.
entries.07c0613b17bcddab2d6136e2a7c9c473a086558d: Approve the proposed lease of Her Majesty the King in Right of Canada, for a period of 20 years, effective January 1, 2025, a site with an area of 941 square metres located on part of Lot 4,727,868 of the Quebec cadastre, forming part of the Lachine Canal, extending Montmorency Street in the South-West District, for maintenance and maintenance of two 600 mm water pipes each, for a total rent of $117,330.78 including taxes
entries.3094e2e0dcf88a2f4138b16bbb0f035cddce5ef8: The City of Montreal (City) has two (2) six hundred (600) millimetre water lines crossing the Lachine Canal along the Montmorency Street extension of the Southwest District. The Lachine Canal and its surroundings are administered by Parks Canada. The City wishes to continue leasing the site with Parks Canada in order to maintain, maintain and use its water infrastructure for a long period of time.
entries.545fa23f9e8f4b0494840ce9bc90b13ba91c8771: Approve the draft addendum 1 amending the Agreement respecting the payment of a financial contribution for the start-up and pre-development of housing projects between the Société d'habitation et de développement de Montréal and the City (CG25 0623)
entries.dd1f2b3450115298d7f0c93a0f7bb0e024cde91c: Provide $1,500,000 in financial support to the École de technologie supérieure to support Ax.c's deployment strategy for a three-year period / Approve draft convention to this effect
entries.86eeda0057008ba5a47e5d1e00f2d13f83773dba: Grant $900,000 in financial support to Essor économique Québec Tech, to accelerate the development of the technological ecosystem of the metropolis, for the period from 2026 to 2029 / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.957b593aa52c6fc975ecda42e02f948b2810a96a: Québec Tech is an economic development organization, a result of the Fondation Montréal inc. founded in 1996 by Pierre Bourque, former mayor of Montreal. Its mission was expanded in 2024 for all of Quebec. It aims to increase the number of successful start-ups in technology.
entries.385bdadb19d9f73bb00f22698b482778b4f63d8f: Provide $600,000 in financial support to Zú for the implementation of the Digital Creativity Innovation and Commercialization Pole project, for the period from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, under the Agreement Réflexe 3 (2025-2029) concluded with the Ministry of Economy, Innovation and Energy / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.72ffda4f6177bcb58b56f30e3e9eca0d7bbc2726: Founded in 2018, Zú is a technology incubator for creative industries. It offers support programs for startups as well as open innovation services for SMEs and large companies, supporting the emergence and growth of creative and technological enterprises. Over the last three years, the organization has received $375,000 in financial support from the City as part of a call for projects to support business incubators and accelerators.
entries.b17f3ce171e966989a3017f70628a16e0ce96005: Grant $100,000 in financial support to L'Anonyme U.I.M. for the implementation of its "Stop-Respite" project for the period ending June 30, 2026 / Approve draft convention to this effect
entries.b31a2418b741b9a3a0168280af715d96c06588ae: Social issues affecting vulnerable people continue to grow in Montreal, resulting in a diversification of profiles, increased needs and increasing pressure on living environments. To address this issue, the City triples the budget dedicated to homelessness and social cohabitation in 2026. In view of the specific challenges of camps and related cohabitation, the City favours a humane approach, focusing on dignity and respect, in accordance with its Municipal Camp Management Protocol - Accompanying the Transition.
entries.1d8a19460a4171002f2482a23cf332fed2487dde: Contract with Groupe de sécurité Garda s.e.n.c., for security services at the UCI Route World Championships Montreal 2026 (lots 1 and 2), for a period of one month - Total expenditure of $880,543.17, including taxes - Public tender 26-21370 (4 som.)
entries.07623213adec53d8f6fb341e4f931fcf9a5ec4d1: As part of the preparations related to the holding of the UCI Route Montréal 2026 World Championships, the City of Montreal must ensure the deployment of all necessary security officers and supervisors to ensure the safety of the public, participants and participants, as well as the smooth running of this major international sporting event. The UCI Route Montréal 2026 World Championships will take place in the territory of the City of Montreal from September 19 to 27, 2026 and will bring together athletes, technical teams and officials from many countries. This major event is an important lever of international visibility for Montreal and highlights its recognized expertise in hosting and organizing major sporting events.
entries.27b2a81f440caf3d97493fcc6261ba3cd7b3b6ca: Completing framework agreements with Metropolitan Tires Inc. for the maintenance, repair and replacement of tires and rims for the rolling stock and workshop department's mechanical workshops, lasting two years for lots 3 and 4, including a 12-month extension option for each batch - Estimated amount of agreements: $1,163,592.51, taxes included - Public Call for Bids 26-21396 (5 sum)
entries.add544cde428f8d3b8bd78fa1a9b79f30b34934e: The mission of the Rolling Stock and Workshop Service (SMRA) is to ensure the availability and reliability of vehicles and equipment, as well as to provide a variety of specialized services and products tailored to the needs of boroughs and central services in an environmentally responsible and secure environment. As part of planning the operational load of mechanical workshops, SMRA has identified the need to mark up ways of providing repair, replacement and road services for vehicle tyres including heavy-duty vehicles for fifteen (15) of the city's mechanical workshops. SMRA thus focuses on its primary mission, namely the maintenance and mechanical repair of vehicles and equipment on a daily basis.
entries.9649c3f80220de0e8bcc787c5bbc62f37928896e: Authorize an additional expenditure of $5,007,540.38, including taxes, as a contingency budget and quantity variation, for household garbage disposal services under contracts awarded to Complexe Enviro Connexions ltée, GFL Environmental inc., Recyclage Notre-Dame inc. and WM Québec inc. (CG22,0407), thereby increasing the total contract amount to $39,022,955.75, including taxes
entries.4e9d80a2a3d8fd96627676db7c9fcc2a7a6808fd: Under section 16 and subsection 6 of section 19 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (RRLQ, chapter E - 20. 001 - Law 75), disposal and recovery of residual materials is an agglomeration jurisdiction. Under section 17 of the Act, the central municipality may act with respect to residual materials constituting the agglomeration jurisdiction, not only within its territory but also over that of any other related municipality. The Environmental and Ecological Transition Service assumes this responsibility for the agglomeration.
entries.b00c484b55972ef8bd7a4daa43762ddc107aedaa: Approve the draft act by which the City assigns to Communia, without financial compensation, its rights in the emphyteose of buildings located at 7520-7530 and 7540-7550 André-Ampère Avenue, in the borough of Rivière-des-Prairies–Pointe-aux-Trembles, which are known and designated as Lots 1,057,697 and 1,057,698 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montréal, all in accordance with the conditions specified in the draft acts
entries.122273390d1822d03f1cd90c9b235731536005fb: Authorize an additional expenditure of $2,516,716.70, including taxes, for household garbage disposal services under contracts awarded to Recyclage Notre-Dame inc. and WM Québec inc. (CG23 0330), increasing the total contract amount to $13,086,926.84, including taxes
entries.0b3aba66a355338a2e7831593e3ea72c56b6fc0f: Under section 16 and subsection 6 of section 19 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (R.S.Q.; chapter E-20.001, Act 75), disposal and valorisation of residual materials constitutes an agglomeration jurisdiction. Under section 17 of that Act, the central municipality may act with respect to matters constituting the responsibilities of agglomeration not only in its territory but also in that of any other related municipality. The Environmental and Ecological Transition Service assumes this responsibility for the agglomeration.
entries.c9ed0edff7feed4dd6820addbb5bc2fc955da937: The Ville de Montréal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean up wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate (WED) is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater, carrying out projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. To this end, television inspections using a towed camera (TVCC) were carried out to assess the condition of the collector located below Saint-Antoine Street, between Robert-Bourassa Boulevard and Saint-Pierre Street.
entries.1028e8b6d46ab08f559342c56f4ca90fdbe299e7: Écoquartier Louvain's project is subject to the Major Projects Governance Framework and was awarded its point of transition to the implementation phase in April 2024. Écoquartier Louvain's project aims at the redevelopment of a 7.7-hectare municipal land located in the district of Ahuntsic-Cartierville. The site is bordered to the north by the Canadian National (CN) railway right-of-way and by a high voltage line from Hydro-Québec, south by Rue de Louvain Est, west by Rue Saint-Hubert and east by Christophe-Colomb Avenue.
entries.658df71bf0a2e76a96bcf9808adfcfd8b2509e27: As with any court in Quebec and Canada, the municipal court, where the usual language of proceedings is French, has a constitutional obligation to provide interpretation services to the parties who so require, as well as to witnesses called in certain cases. The latter must be able to translate, under oath, in full and faithfully, the testimony given, impartially and in strict compliance with the rules laid down by the higher courts in this matter. The Legal Affairs Service (JSA) is responsible for ensuring that these professional services are provided on an ongoing basis, in accordance with the demands of the court and the requirements of the law.
entries.6ad0dc7bee213885c55fbd4abbdebc033d66c802: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater, carrying out projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. In this context, television inspections using a towed camera (CCTV) were carried out to assess the condition of the collector located below Nicolet Street, between Adam Street and Notre-Dame East Streets.
entries.8eda6756d37586f1125ec0e139be97ae2ba1a8a1: Provide $25,110,800 in financial support to Société du Patrimoine Angus Residential, for the construction of 350 affordable housing units on lots 6,232, 022, 6,232, 023, 6,322,743 and 6,322,744 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, in the borough of Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie / Authorize an additional budget of expenditures equivalent to the corresponding additional income / Approve the draft agreement for this purpose / Authorize equivalent revenue and expenditure budgets to the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service, according to the contribution agreement, for an amount of $25,110,800
entries.00d4d15913a57fdf9886dd0d60ce79a1c7b93e33: On July 17, 2024, the Government of Quebec adopted Order No. 1167-2024 under which the Société d'Habitation du Québec (hereinafter "SHQ") was authorized to grant a grant to the Société du Patrimoine Angus Residential (hereinafter "the Organization") in order to permit the implementation and operation of 1,001 affordable housing units on the territory of Montreal (2 projects) and Rimouski (1 project). The terms and conditions for granting this grant were established in a Grant Agreement for the Implementation and Operation of Affordable Housing Projects concluded between the SHQ and the Agency on July 26, 2024 in accordance with Decree No. 1167-2024 (as amended by the subsequent Order of March 24, 2026 in accordance with Decree No. 384-2026 of March 19, 2026 below "Agreement").
entries.8769c27a74e4642535bab965fb8c3057322e2ace: Approve the draft amendment 1 to the financial assistance agreement between the City of Montreal and the Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation as part of the work on the revision of the Plan d'aménagement et de développement de l'agglomeration de Montréal for the integration of new government guidelines in land use planning (CG25 0081)
entries.d0838356739299352c9aed72a45e2b39f6eeb2b7: On March 10, 2026, the Minister asked the agglomeration, under the Planning and Town Planning Act (LAU), to revise its layout and development plan (schema). The objective is to ensure consistency with both the new Government Directions in Land Management (OGAT) adopted on December 1, 2024, and the revised Metropolitan Plan for Development (PMADR) of the CMM, which came into force on December 11, 2025. Given the different concordance deadlines set out in the UAA to comply with OGAT (three years) and LDCDR (two years), a common three-year schedule was established by the Minister.
entries.8b79095900cb6486708d4fade6d3d17e03415ac8: Conclude four framework agreements with Ideal Spring Ltd. (Lot 1) and Le Groupe Guy inc. (Lots 2, 3 and 4) for the City of Montreal's preventive maintenance and heavy vehicle repair services for a 12-month period, including two 12-month extension options - Estimated amount of agreements: $2,280,195.79 including taxes - Public tender 26-21329 (5 Som.)
entries.0d9fe91e839794cd8dd241e39f2aaba9545cfff5: The mission of the Rolling Stock and Workshop Service (SMRA) is to ensure the availability and reliability of vehicles and equipment, as well as to provide a variety of specialized services and products tailored to the needs of boroughs and central services, in an environmentally responsible manner and in a safe environment. In order to achieve its objectives of making aircraft available, complying with contractual management regulations, and ensuring optimal short- and long-term planning for its operations, SMRA wishes to obtain preventive mechanical maintenance and heavy vehicle repair services, which led to the launch of the public tender No. 26-21329.
entries.8a9594ec7e7253b690c19296514db4a8226e7b3a: Approve the proposed bilateral promise by which the City undertakes to sell to the Société de transport de Montréal, a vacant land of approximately 202.8 square metres, known and designated as part of Lot 2,652,264 du cadastre du Québec, consisting of a portion of Jean-Brillant Street, at the corner of Victoria Street, in the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, in order to permit the construction of an adjustment post, for the sum of $115,000, plus applicable taxes / Authorize the Société de transport de Montréal to begin construction work on the rectification post on said part of Lot 2,652,264 du cadastre du Québec
entries.8dfd83c6aee4c36406ef77491ae7bec5aa19d19b: Approve a draft act amending the emphyteosis between the City of Montreal and Maison Aurélie-Cadotte for the property located at 56 Sherbrooke Street East, in the borough of Ville-Marie, to extend the term of the emphyteosis by an additional period of 46 years, from November 6, 2037 until November 5, 2083, the annual annuity of which will be $7,600 in order to allow the reconstruction of the property, all under the conditions stipulated in the draft Act / Mandate the Real Estate Strategy and Housing Service in order to prepare a contribution agreement establishing disbursements for the financial assistance of $6,200,000 reserved for Maison Aurélie-Cadotte for the reconstruction of the building located at 56 Sherbrooke Street East, in the borough of Ville-Marie / Approve a clearance project in which Maison Aurélie-Cadotte and the City renounce each other any recourse in connection with the fire of the Monastery of Bon-Pasteur on May 25, 2023
entries.f03f7523bb816f1213f1cadf2fc80b9c7b4ab44a: On May 25, 2023, a major fire ravaged the Monastery of Bon-Pasteur, a heritage building located on Sherbrooke Street East, between the streets of Bullion and Saint-Dominique in the arrondissement of Ville-Marie. The building owned by the City of Montreal (the City) was sold as an emphyteose to three organizations in the 1980s. The section located at 56 Sherbrooke Street East (the Building) is currently under emphyteosis with Maison Aurélie-Cadotte (the Emphyteote), a non-profit organization that acts as a shelter for independent seniors aged 55 and over.
entries.aec4bb693fa520b5493dc93a69c43c9259ec9ea1: Authorize the renegotiation of the next framework agreement between the City of Montreal, Bibliothèque et Archives nationales du Québec and the Minister of Culture and Communications / Notify stakeholders / Mandate the Culture, Sports and Recreation Service and the City's Office for Government and Municipal Relations to renegotiate the terms of the said framework agreement
entries.35e5133bca600f875e052cc3b2c3a081a1de12f5: Delegating to the municipal council the design, coordination, management and execution of work relating to the project for the restoration and creation of wetlands and water in the wooded area of Parc Marcel-Laurin in the borough of Saint-Laurent, as long as necessary to complete the project, in accordance with section 48 of the Act respecting the exercise of certain municipal powers in certain agglomerations (RLRQ, c. E-20.001)
entries.8420a0db43f70d266c31fc48c94ef928f80b8da7: The forest of Parc Marcel-Laurin (hereinafter the Boisé) is a 15.44 hectare natural environment composed of two segments of streams as well as a network of marshes and swamps, which has been listed in the Directory of Protected Natural Environments and Contributing to Biodiversity in the Montréal Agglomeration since 2009. Financial Assistance for the Project In 2021, the borough of Saint-Laurent applied for a grant under Part 2 of the Program for the Restoration and Creation of Wetlands and Watercourses (PRCMHH) of the Ministry of the Environment and the Fight against Climate Change, Wildlife and Parks (MELCCFP; summary 1207220010).
entries.fb31107810fd94cc43118961bd1959d1579cbeae: Authorize the signing of the letter of no objection in response to the Notice of Railway Works pursuant to section 8(1) of the Railway Safety Act - Reconstruction of the Tunnel Bridge (R.S.C. 1985, c. 32 (4th Supp.)), located under the tracks of Canadian Pacific Kansas City, over the new Metropolitan Express Network in Montreal, between Jean-Talon Street West and Wilderton Street, in the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce
entries.90f93cbdd70d26be49e827f7d10625163c833780: Project REM s.e.c., managed by CDPQ Infra (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec), has the mandate to reconstruct the tunnel bridge that accommodates the Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) rail tracks between Jean-Talon Street West and Wilderton Street, near Canora Station, located in the arrondissement of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce. This tunnel bridge is directly above the new Metropolitan Express Network (MMN), and its useful life is now exceeded. The targeted work consists of the reconstruction of the existing tunnel bridge along Jean-Talon Street West, at Wilderton Street, at mileage CPKC: PM 48.78, below the tracks on which CPKC acts as a railway company ("the Ways").
entries.d221aa1c4e6eee177e1f0e1d4ebb7ad5a92fbacc: Authorize carry-over to November 1, 2026 or March 1, 2027, depending on the class or value of the building, the deadline granted to the assessor to respond to requests for review filed against three-year roles 2026-2027-2028
entries.be96e4d7ef25fcc21ea9d45dec2b2cd3781cc748: Approve the out-of-court settlement in the amount of $1,000,000 in capital, interest, compensation Approve the out-of-court settlement in the amount of $1,000,000 in capital, interest, additional indemnity and costs, of an action brought by Rosemary Lafrenière against the City for disguised expropriation in respect of three vacant lots bearing numbers 1,456,704, 1,456,705 and 1,456,725 of the cadastre du Québec, now owned by the City, whose dispute had been limited to establishing the market value of those lands / Authorize the establishment of the date of taking possession on October 28, 2022 strictly for the purpose of adjusting property taxes
entries.d0be776c4713f025d92882acde1f79734ecabe06: In March 2023, Rosemary Lafrenière ("Ms. Lafrenière") instituted proceedings in the Superior Court against the City for disguised expropriation, claiming an expropriation indemnity of at least $553,700 and reimbursement of municipal taxes paid since 2020. In September 2023, this compensation was revised upwards following a preliminary appraisal by an assessment firm totalling $1,270,568.49, subject to review. In October 2023, the City filed defences for the claim.
entries.cab7b1bf03d267cc28971028b4058ba356ffc61f: Approve the draft financial assistance agreements between the City of Montreal and each of the related cities under Phase 2 of the Accelerating Local Climate Transition Program
entries.4f436d4e613d343dbb1ce77b5e8e2bd880448b42: In December 2020, the City of Montreal adopted its Climate Plan 2020-2030 to deliver on its commitments to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and adapt to climate change. This Plan is part of the City's strategic objectives, Montréal 2030 and is directly linked to the Government of Quebec's Green Economy Plan (GEP), a bold plan that focuses on the essential role of municipalities in achieving global climate goals across Québec. The Government of Quebec's ENP Implementation Plan 2025-2030 provides that the Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation (MAMH) and the Ministère de l'Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs (MELCCFP) are jointly responsible for Action 4.2.1.2 – Accelerating local climate transition (ATCL).

entries.cadf46744002376422f3208d2664d0f3b467f840: Given the intensification of the homelessness crisis in its territory, the City of Montreal is called upon to strengthen its intervention levers in order to support structural initiatives aimed at people living in or at risk of homelessness. The increase in homelessness, in a context of crisis of affordability of housing, rising costs of living and more complex social needs, puts greater pressure on the sharing of public space and existing resources, and highlights the need to increase the capacity to finance interventions, in addition to the public investments already made. It was with this in mind that the City announced on February 19, 2026, its intention to establish a mechanism for mobilizing private contributions in support of homelessness-related projects.

entries.5749861ecfe02cc71ab1267d1280cbab4fe23b9a: As part of the municipal amalgamations, the City of Montreal undertook an important process to harmonize pension plans for professional employees. The objective of this process was to standardize the retirement conditions applicable to future service while respecting the rights acquired under previous plans. On December 15, 2010, the Executive Committee approved the harmonization agreement between the City and the four (4) unions representing professional employees.
entries.cc2df89975cc07f17339ca9025bde91596e85dbc: Name the Parc des Soeurs-de-Sainte-Anne, in the district of Lachine
entries.51e170e186e987e14507788c65cc85a25f921ece: In February 2024, the district of Lachine contacted the Heritage Division to initiate a process to appoint a new park. The park in question is located on the site of the Mother House of the Congregation of the Sisters of Sainte-Anne, on land that was transferred to the borough by the congregation in 2020. The borough proposed to name it "Sisters of Saint Anne Park", so that the heritage of the Congregation and its major role in the development of Lachine would be permanently inscribed in the territory.
entries.a576257210dafff8c5ac96ce3190f1f9264526ed: Name the Place des Cantonniers in the arrondissement of Côte-des-Neiges– Notre-Dame-de-Grâce
entries.8b87f40678ae2e76d273ac5e2f2ac361f12e9396: In early 2024, the borough Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce contacted the Heritage Division to appoint a new public square. This square, created in the wake of the Royalmount project, is associated with the development of a bridge over the Décarie highway and linking the Royalmount site to the Savane metro station. The new square is located in the right-of-way of De Sorel Street, between Boulevard Décarie and Rue Bougainville.
entries.3970f8a212d40fce3bf3447934ddcc37bff414e3: Name the Avenue des Solidarités in the Louvain ecoquartier, in the district of Ahuntsic-Cartierville
entries.cc53c00aee5101b00e6c0e74fdda64d1630d6f61: In 2023, the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville and the Urban Projects Division (UMD) team initiated a project to redevelopment the Louvain ecoquartier. As part of the Major Project Governance Framework, the Louvain ecoquartier project aims to redevelop a 7.7 hectare municipal land in the Ahuntsic-Cartierville borough. The site is bordered north by the Canadian National Railway Right-of-way (CN) and a high voltage line from Hydro-Québec, south by Rue de Louvain Est, west by Rue Saint-Hubert and east by Christophe-Colomb Avenue.

entries.95e198a0955af02822a15e7281383218ea413872: The City of Montreal (City) has a 10-year vision, Montréal 2030, to address today's challenges and better prepare for tomorrow's challenges. entries.6218814740382a13f76afd985b0bbb2ad333d601: The purpose of this dossier is to conclude two framework agreements for the supply and delivery on demand of polymer bollards, delineators and accessories, primarily designed to delineate lanes, secure pedestrian areas and cycle paths, and guide traffic without causing significant damage to vehicles in the event of impact. These framework agreements will be made available to all business units in the City of Montreal. For several years, the acquisition of bollards and delinquents was carried out mainly by the City's business units on a voluntary basis, particularly due to urgent needs related to the securing of certain sectors, the progressive standardization of models preferred by technical teams, and the variability of volumes ordered by the boroughs.

entries.a276dc988fb4fde84898fd82d14f2f383b53c2f6: The mission of the Rolling Stock and Workshop Service (SMRA) is to ensure the availability and reliability of vehicles and equipment, as well as to provide a variety of specialized services and products tailored to the needs of boroughs and central services in an environmentally responsible and safe environment. In order to optimize the planning of the operational load of mechanical workshops, the SMRA has, for more than fifteen (15) years, identified a constant need for electrical and electronic parts essential to the maintenance of the municipal motor vehicle fleet. The strategy adopted is to target brands generating the most significant volumes of purchases in monetary terms, in order to ensure extensive coverage of electrical and electronic parts requirements.

entries.b679164e6f9ca153dbd1b4dd02b2fe97002a9d51: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water to the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater, to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. entries.128e70e4348e72d8868a0a7b620453f3858c51c1: Grant an OTC contract to Tetra Tech QI inc., for professional services for the integration of Saint-Jacques and Courcelles retention structures into the integrated interceptor control system - Total expenditure of $790,418.63, including taxes (exclusive supplier)
entries.016df8d8fcb3a2b7cab5044f2aeb54a4294ec4b2: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater, ensure public health and safety, and protect the environment, now and for future generations. The Integrated Interceptor Control System (CIDI) is a unique innovation in Canada in reducing rain showers in an urban agglomeration of Montréal's size.

entries.7a339496418504f78c8ba60bc15b31ad052410b0: Since January 1, 2018, as part of the consolidation of real estate activities within the Real Property Management and Planning Service (RPMS), the Security Directorate (formerly Security Division) became responsible for the custodianship contract for the Space for Life (EPLV) facilities. entries.e7ad078966977c6937d9aaeb35da098261ab8e51: As part of the Nature and Sports Plan, the Service des grands parcs, du Mont-Royal et des sports (SMPMRS) has been implementing various actions for several years aimed at maintaining populations of amphibians, reptiles and waterbirds in the system of large parks. The brown snake, which is present exclusively in the metropolitan area of Montreal, is particularly vulnerable due to the decline of its habitats. Since 2022, this species has been designated as threatened under Quebec's Threatened and Vulnerable Species Act.

entries.2e6d477d34a618942205a7466fa6654ce495353f: Description of the REQ The Régroupement des éco-quartiers (REQ) is a not-for-profit organization founded in 1999 and composed of the organizations carrying out the City of Montreal's eco-neighbourhood programs (PEQ). Today, it brings together 11 organizations providing PEQ in 16 boroughs. The REQ's mission is to represent its members to the municipal administration and the general public and to ensure the sustainability of the program.
entries.ea07dedccb92cbcdf25baa2416e7cc152af0fd2f: As part of the Bonaventure Highway Development Project and Griffintown development projects, several hydraulic studies were carried out to analyse the network serving the Saint-Jacques-D-Youville drainage basin. In the analysis of the Saint-Jacques collector, it was found that the latter had deficiencies during rains with a recurrence equal to or less than 1:10 years. The functional deficiencies observed stem mainly from a lack of hydraulic capacity on certain sections of the collector.
entries.c49ac1a9f9e1bb90b7f3972c91538ce1279ba705: The mission of the Rolling Stock and Workshop Service is to ensure the availability and reliability of vehicles and equipment, as well as to provide a variety of specialized services and products tailored to the needs of boroughs and central services, in an environmentally responsible manner and in a safe environment. The Rolling Stock Service continues to improve its practices by more rigorously evaluating the purchase of brakes in order to reduce out-of-agreement expenses.

entries.5687b96d4e5f91a20e6af3be43f67290df41719c: The City of Montreal is committed to an ambitious program to rehabilitate and repair its water infrastructure, both in terms of the production and distribution of drinking water and the collection and treatment of wastewater.
