As part of planning the operational load of mechanical workshops, SMRA has identified the need to mark up ways of providing repair, replacement and road services for vehicle tires, including heavy vehicles, for the City's mechanical workshops. SMRA has entered into contracts for maintenance, repair and replacement of tires and rims for mechanical workshops.
entries.3e62dc9c8a663262ac9f51cc3e345776fd9e032e: Approve the proposed lease by which the City leases to the Société environnementale de Côte-des-Neiges, for a term of one year, retroactive to January 1, 2026, a portion of land located in the arrondissement of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, at the southeast corner of the Chemin de la Côte-des-Neiges and the track, bearing lot number 2,515 576 of the cadastre du Québec, electoral district of Montreal, having an area of 957 square meters, in order to organize composting activities for citizens, on a free basis. The total grant for this occupation is $13,428 for the term
entries.e2f2cd1f93ded1bdb036a65cc94e82bbe99c6dbc: The Société en environnementale de Côte-des-Neiges (SOCENV) is a non-profit organization founded on March 27, 1996. Since April 1, 2016, it has occupied land in the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce (the "Arrondissement") which it has developed, notably for composting activities. SOCENV has implemented a multifunctional project involving the development of a composting site, the upgrading of a small woodlot and urban farming activities.
entries.aa84caeeeffbc766b5525d7b36742fd1b3e0381a: Exercising the option of a second 12-month extension, without additional expense, for the provision of telecommunications equipment with support, under the contract awarded to Bell Canada (CG22 0190)
entries.1806865f886ec648e0cb40e0bc91aeaeb65cf68d: Exercising the option of the first 12-month extension and authorizing an additional expenditure of $1,463,611.35, including taxes, for towing services, under contracts awarded to Burstall-Conrad towing inc., Centre-Ville towing inc., Meteor towing inc. and Bélanger S. R. Towing inc. (CG23 0335), thereby increasing the total contract amount to $6,723,498.98, including taxes
entries.33fcdde6451043a4e2f42478f62307e7f3152c42: Since 2017, vehicle towing has become an agglomeration jurisdiction. Within the agglomeration, it is the City of Montreal Police Service (SPVM) that is responsible for overseeing towing activities. The Vehicle Towing Regulations (RCG19-004) were passed in 2019 giving authority to the SPVM's Towing Inspection Section (SIR) to enforce regulations and contract management.
entries.0922bec8b590c7bb8a8fc1bbd6f50084e62bd993: Exercising the option of the second 12-month extension and authorizing an additional expenditure of $302,519.82 including taxes, for household maintenance services at the headquarters of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal under the contract awarded to Service d'maintenance Alphanet inc. (CG22 0023), thereby increasing the total contract amount to $1,512,599.09, including taxes
entries.468e4e80b316954166a205a09b3a847891d9cc9a: In 2021, the Supply Service issued a public tender No. 21-18986 for a housekeeping service at the Headquarters of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal (SPVM). This interview is normally carried out by a private company. The purpose of this file is therefore to exercise the second twelve (12) month extension option, from April 1, 2026 until March 31, 2027.
entries.e2b612c63733b84b5e47ddf811f567bdd5a4ab1f: Authorize the transfer of $121,873.50, including taxes, from incidental work contract expenses (CG24 0431) to contingent professional services contract expenditures (CG25 0204), under the contract awarded to Bouthilliette Parizeau inc. and Lafontaine Langford Architectes n.e.c. (CG25 0204) for the repair of ventilation and gas capture systems at Viau Municipal Workshops, thereby increasing the contingency budget to $261,249.63, including taxes, without additional expenses
entries.c25ffa0fe34d56dabb75ece2e9291bd6d9ed78ab: Authorize the transfer to Essor économique Québec Tech of two financial contribution agreements concluded between the City and Fondation Montréal inc. of tomorrow, for the realization of projects supporting the ecosystem of technological startups (CG25 0330, CG25 0444) / Approve the draft agreement of assignment to this effect
entries.0468f6adc735655628ce8c295ad34b8f44af721f: In August 2024, the Montreal Foundation Inc. of tomorrow, a non-profit organization (NPB) recognized as a charity and previously also acting under the name Startup Montréal MC, began to act as Québec Tech MC. This change was accompanied by a mandate now extended to all of Quebec, funded by a $7 million contribution from the Ministère de l'Économie, de l'Innovation et de l'Énergie du Québec (MEIE) within the framework of the Strategy québécoise de recherche et d'investissement en innovation 2022-2027. The main objective of this new mandate was to make Québec a global reference for the creation and development of technological startups with high growth and export potential.
entries.6f5a199aff411bcd6e9fde5259bb8c474e707ad2: Allow an additional expenditure of $536,301.40, including taxes, as a contingency budget for Lot 2 for the City's traditional telephony services, under the framework agreements with Bell Canada (CG22,0645), increasing the total amount of agreements to $18,294,324.12, including taxes
entries.28322901b13cfabb21782f25615430e18ccffa7d: To authorize an additional expenditure of $1,055,231.53, including taxes, for the reconstruction of a 750 mm diameter main water line and replacement of water service entrances under Saint-Antoine Street West between Rose-de-Lima Street and Atwater Avenue under contract to 9200-2088 Québec inc. (Duroking Construction) (CG21 0277), thereby increasing the total contract amount to $5,869,794.02, including taxes
entries.ab4bcd0c0682f1562812341daf36a6c4de63b5d1: The Ville de Montréal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water for the Montreal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater in order to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment today and for future generations. The Water Systems Directorate is responsible for the distribution of quality drinking water and the collection of wastewater by carrying out projects to upgrade and develop network assets, while ensuring their operation and maintenance. The City of Montreal awarded a contract to Duroking Construction (Duroking) in May 2021 for the reconstruction of a 750 mm diameter prestressed concrete pipe with steel cylinder type (C301) and replacement of water service entrances under Saint-Antoine Street West between Rose-de-Lima Street and Atwater Avenue.
entries.ab2db21aea513b323bfe07f39697e01c4df91bab: Approve a draft bill extending emphyteosis between the City of Montreal and the Coopérative d'habitation Bonheur d'Occasion, for the property located at 1746, 1760, 1822 and 1800 Darling Street in the district of Mercier–Hochelaga-Maisonneuve, to extend the term of emphyteosis by an additional 13 years, from March 31, 2039 until March 30, 2052, with an annual annuity of $6,400. The annual annuity granted represents a total grant of at least $1,160,000 for the extension period.
entries.ca91accff5cd82d1000805fdc2e95668565a3a14: Approve the Sectoral Agreement in Circular Economy between the Minister of Economy, Innovation and Energy, the Société québécoise de recuperation et de recyclé, the École de technologie supérieure and the City for a total amount of $1,295,000 covering the period from 2026 to 2028 / Reserve an amount of $300,000 for this purpose
entries.d220d561fc3bb92d49a2bc566d0fedeaa51dd1a4: To meet its commitments to climate, ecological transition and economic prosperity, the City of Montreal has set a target of doubling its circulatory index by 2030 from 3% to 6%, reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 55% and moving towards zero waste. In support of this transition, in April 2025, it tabled Action Plan 2025-2027, which emerged from the Montreal Circular Economy Roadmap 2024-2030. Action 10 of this plan provides for the implementation of structural initiatives aimed at stimulating ecosystems in the five priority sector value chains, including construction, renovation and demolition.
entries.61f8c7abb1f08d5d1e0c11ab72a052a6916f9609: To conclude a framework agreement with Bureau Veritas Canada (2019) Inc., for 36-month water sample analysis services, including a 12-month extension option - Estimated amount of the agreement: $1,361,444.52, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 25-21210 (3 sum)
entries.22a7b5fcc20642594257b8f3dba80c3c5dbef447: The purpose of this file is to enter into a framework agreement for the provision, upon request, of analytical services for various water samples (clean and dirty matrices), primarily for laboratory bacteriological testing on different types of samples from various matrices as well as for reporting purposes. This framework agreement will be made available to all business units in the City of Montreal. In April 2024, the contract for the supply, upon request, of laboratory analysis services was awarded, in accordance with public tender documents 23-20289, to the lowest compliant bidder, Bureau Veritas Canada (2019) Inc., for an estimated total amount of $860,811.08 including taxes.
entries.cd9ec6b526fedbda030de8faa0c87a16ff1ce064: Conclude a framework agreement with 9140-2594 Québec inc. (Construction Arcade), for general works in the City's plants, pumping stations and reservoirs, lasting 36 months, including two extension options of 12 months each - Estimated amount of the agreement: $14,476,599.60, taxes included - Public tender DEP-P2612-C (3 sum)
entries.a17fe5ad0542f27ea0e25b7a717b1482deb5cf10: The City of Montreal Water Service's mission is to provide drinking water to the Montréal community, manage stormwater and clean wastewater, to ensure public health and safety and protect the environment, now and for future generations. The Montreal Drinking Water Directorate (PWD) is responsible for a number of facilities including 6 treatment plants, 14 reservoirs and pumping stations. The Drinking Water Directorate regularly conducts work on these facilities to maintain them in good condition to continue to produce sufficient quality drinking water.
entries.d7cdfb817a8b42c10fd68865ab7b588bf250790a: Conclude a framework agreement with Les Packagings Carrousel inc., for the supply of plastic bags for the stocking of individual protective equipment of the Montreal Fire Safety Service, lasting three years - Estimated amount of the agreement: $545,740.34, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 25-21156 (1 compliant sum)
entries.24f3cf36164386af7abbcfb726bc2e2fce043412: The Montreal Fire Safety Service (IMS) must protect the health and safety of its personnel in order to prevent occupational accidents and diseases. In the performance of their duties, firefighters and firefighters may be exposed to contaminants on site. To reduce this risk, SIM has developed a course consisting of contamination reduction areas that is put in place during intervention.
entries.58cea6eaf19e1a5d13986a537458470095ab0e92: Develop a framework agreement with the Government Acquisitions Centre for membership in the 60-month grouping of cellular mobility goods and services - Estimated amount of the agreement: $16,800,000, including taxes
entries.970f209bdb4f505fdafeadeabad23fa7399961f0: Completing framework agreements with Roland Grenier Construction Ltd. and Mecanicaction Inc., for general works covering various buildings in the City, for a period of 36 months, including two 12-month extension options - Estimated amount of agreements: $9,588,954.94, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 25-21232 (3 sum)
entries.9047a842dd30229051ca57c6ad5583588aa6045e: This file deals with the granting of three (3) framework agreements for the provision of services upon request for general works. These framework agreements are of a duration of thirty-six (36) months, from April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2029, with two (2) extension options of twelve (12) months each. Public tender No. 25-21232 was launched and published from November 19, 2025 to January 15, 2026 on the Government of Quebec's Electronic Tendering System (EOTS) and in Le Devoir.
entries.89777f75b4cb67da4583e52f7d26342998bd8c90: Contract with UAP Inc. to provide a cloud-based vehicle diagnostic and technical reference solution for 36 months, including two 12 month extension options each - Total expenditure of $867,933.26, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 25-21201 (3 sum)
entries.89f02924f97e752e3c7877760412a03964fafc89: Award a contract to Cloud Monitored Objects Inc. for the support and maintenance services of vehicular communication equipment for the Montreal Fire Safety Service, for a period of two years, including two extension options of 12 months each - Total expenditure of $765,701.31, including taxes - Public tender 25-21182 (2 sum)
entries.026be5c354d0b14adaa6a2416b4f2ba00d43031b: Grant a contract to Mécanique Northerm inc. for the decarbonization of the cavalry building of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, located at 1515 Remembrance Road - Total expenditure of $1,309,954.10, including taxes - Public tender IMM-15983 (7 sum)
entries.6763d7a38ca569924ef5c53b3c61bcbe5adc183a: As part of the Government of Quebec's 2030 Green Economy Implementation Plan (GEP), the Ministère de l'Environnement et de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs (MELCCFP) and the City of Montreal (Ville) signed a grant agreement on March 28, 2022 (Agreement) to enable the latter to implement certain measures in its Climate Plan 2020 - 2030 (Climate Plan) that meet the objectives of the MOP. The Agreement contributes in particular to supporting the financing of decarbonation projects for thirty-two (32) buildings identified by the Building Management and Planning Service (SGPI) as one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases (GHGs) in municipal real estate (Parc). The objective over time is to reduce emissions by approximately 7,000 tonnes eq.
entries.ba76ccb64a2190fd069e4073f2d4aa64a21965f9: Grant an OTC contract to Astral Display, for the provision of advertising space in the Société de transport de Montréal network as well as in Astral's display network for Espace pour la vie in 2026 - Total expenditure of $172,462.50, including taxes
entries.ad019dbaccdf1e5f97e149156481a336374cc162: Each year, Espace pour la vie presents in its five museums (Biodôme, Biosphere, Insectarium, Jardin botanique and Planetarium) events, films and exhibitions. In order to achieve its objectives of attendance (2.4 million visits planned in 2026), and therefore of revenues, several promotional campaigns are implemented, including the purchase of advertising spaces in a diversity of media (daily, display, quarterly, weekly, digital advertisements, etc.). Astral Affichage offers advertising space on a variety of media (lumiquias, panobus, Metrovision, etc.) in the collective transportation network of the Société de transport de Montréal (STM), which serves a large number of users and users, public that Espace pour la vie wishes to join to promote its various events.
entries.1d01ab7281d1a31fa89895e379e8bd5c4225b159: Grant two contracts to Bell Canada (Lot 1) and ITI Inc. (Lot 2) for Cisco Network Equipment Maintenance Services, for a period of 36 months - Total Expenditure: $1,085,194.61, including Taxes - Public Call for Bids 25-21258 (2 Som)
entries.f852f4d61ebe99322e0db8b7c9634df7f196c24d: Provide $69,076.09 in financial support to the Eco-Quarter Grouping, to organize Blue Patrol for the 2026 season / Approve draft convention to this effect
entries.7412aeca71e5c28f6dd922b7eeb496333994f47d: The Regroupement des éco-quartiers (REQ) is a not-for-profit organization representing a network of actors deeply rooted in the community and whose approach focuses on environmental education, awareness raising, information and active participation of citizens. The Blue Patrol, initiated by the Water Service, has been coordinated by the REQ since its creation in 2010 thanks to the financial contribution of the City of Montreal's Water Service. To date, the Blue Patrol has directly sensitized more than 130,000 people on water issues and measures to save drinking water.
entries.9da097b194b97f27a7b1ed3986fccceb95c58572: Provide $140,000 in financial support to the Montreal International Institute for Administrative Studies as part of the organization of the 32nd edition of the Montreal Conference / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.607dc68ffaa8599ba59ba1fc23ae4e0647cea9ae: The Montreal International Institute of Administrative Studies (IIÉAM), also known as the International Economic Forum of the Americas (IEAF), has submitted to the Economic Development Service (EDS) a request for financial contributions in the amount of $175,000 for the 32nd edition of the Montreal Conference (CdeM), which will be held from June 8 to 10, 2026 at the Bonaventure Hotel. The CdeM is a meeting of world leaders that aims to foster a better understanding of major international issues. It hosts over 250 national and international speakers and more than 2,000 participants from more than 50 countries annually.
entries.ea70240bacd009fd1c9a4ca59448b8e1092a8d52: Providing $300,000 in financial support to Montreal - Métropole en santé, for the implementation of Montreal's action plans, physically active and Conseil du système alimentaire Montréal in order to create environments conducive to healthy lifestyles for all Montrealers, for the period from April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2028, within the framework of the Fonds région et ruralité / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.405231e3b406e191b5df5ecd9e8966c6470ea4d1: Montréal - Métropole en santé (MMS) is a group of Montreal actors working in healthy lifestyles since 2014. It brings together the two major mobilizations that are physically active Montreal (MPA) and the Conseil du système alimentaire Montréal. Its objective is to be recognized as the essential network that makes Montreal an innovative metropolis for the creation of environments conducive to healthy lifestyles, by accompanying, recognizing and supporting structural and sustainable measures.
entries.434ca7f899727c23a512a878f2c17c64ad95628e: Provide $309,848 in financial support to the Centre de valorisation du bois urbain, in order to develop the City of Montreal's wood for the period from March 30, 2026 to December 31, 2027 / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.8e637ecf84e0f6bcf51d3fb7fd0f8c455f937139: The Centre de valorisation du bois urbain (CVBU) is a not-for-profit organization and social economy company whose mission is to develop urban wood in order to maximize its social, economic and environmental benefits. The infestation of the ash grove has forced municipalities to cut down thousands of ash trees each year, thus generating significant quantities of wood. Since 2020, the CVBU has been tasked with upgrading this wood rather than letting it be directed towards conventional disposal.
entries.85394e002e9f0ad164ef246c0ea74527d2cd4a86: Provide $543,812 in financial support to Startop and the Commission du développement économique des First Nations du Québec et du Labrador for their respective projects under the 2030 Economic Plan / Approve draft agreements to this effect
entries.872256b95b24f92ba01eace4f00793d44684d921: Approve the draft of the First Amendment Agreement Amending the Framework Agreement between Mission Units, the City of Montreal and the Municipal Housing Office of Montreal (CG24 0383) / Provide additional financial support of $877 312 to Mission Units / Authorize additional revenues and expenditures of $877 312 for fiscal year 2026
entries.7d9c7b9f2e57611965d3ed409d21e3863e5da249: The Agglomeration Council of 20 June 2024 (CG24 0383) authorized a financial contribution of $3,340,550 to Mission Unités (Organisme) for the implementation of a 100-unit project aimed at an independent elderly clientele. On 28 June 2024, a Framework Agreement between the City of Montreal (City), Mission Unités and the Municipal Housing Office of Montreal (OMHM) was concluded in order to define the terms and conditions under which the Project would be carried out. During the execution of the Project, the Personalization Amount and General Costs were higher than anticipated due to several factors, including an undervaluation of soil decontamination costs, electrical network constraints and installation of noise mitigation measures.
entries.a855c68549c43f162fccef8f10d45bf01dff605a: Approve the draft addendum 1 amending the Grant Agreement between the City and the Société d'habitation du Québec (CG25 0146)
entries.94b9ae193d4e27ea2d449e6698247d3895fd7464: The Council of Agglomeration of March 20, 2025 (CG25 0146) approved a draft grant agreement (hereinafter the Agreement), by which the Société d'habitation du Québec (SHQ) authorized a financial contribution of $5,206,297 to the City of Montreal for the implementation of the modular housing project with accompaniment for homeless persons. Three sites had been identified, i.e. 30 units per site for a total of 90 units. The Agreement initially provided for the payment of the full financial contribution for the substantial completion of projects at all three sites.
entries.c1e2fd41c0d51bbdb6ab7355e9ff2c5fa2440c0e: Approve the addenda to the 2025-2028 delegation agreements to be implemented between the City and the six SME organizations MTL / Authorize the updating of the budgetary parameters relating to the financing of administrative expenses of the six SME organisations MTL
entries.43ee8b8d6457084be187c7c0e56110327f4e8b6c: The SME MTL network offers a range of professional services accessible to private entrepreneurs and social economy companies located on the island of Montreal. From the start-up phase to the growth phase, MTL SME organisations advise and accompany entrepreneurs at each stage of their business development. The network consists of six organizations funded through two main agreements: - The delegation agreement concluded between the City of Montréal and the six organizations of the SME MTL network; - The financial contribution agreement also linking the City to the six organizations.
entries.1a24830620bdd5d998fd4c1df9b9a58a70e7a816: Approve addenda to the 2024-2026 financial contribution agreements between the City and the six SME organizations MTL / Authorize updating of budget parameters for financing management fees and human resources expenditures of the six SME organisations MTL
entries.86bb17e38d0a88d34c05cc971f827d5c870dd5e0: Approve the specific agreement between the Société de transport de Montréal (STM) and the City to entrust STM with carrying out the work as part of the Blue Line Extension / Authorize a total expenditure of $3,808,451.29, including taxes, for this purpose
entries.ef2ce02197bdc77d21d8af4da2af0d5d086db35b: The Société de transport de Montréal (STM) is responsible for the project of Extension of the Blue Line of the Metro (PLB), which provides for the addition of five new stations and extends over approximately 6 km of tunnel, from Saint-Michel station in Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension borough and ending in Anjou district. The project of extension of the Blue Line intervenes significantly in the public domain, notably by excavation of four stations located at the major intersections of Jean-Talon Street East. The underground and surface infrastructure of the street must be reconstructed by STM at the locations of the excavations (see map of the new infrastructures attached).
entries.24b3255149ef8147359609b8724baa90b0f022b7: Approve the Montreal Bio-Food Sector Development Agreement 2026-2029 for a total amount of $1,402,740 with Quebec Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food, Minister of Economy, Innovation and Energy, and Minister of Employment and Social Solidarity / Approve the Financial Assistance Agreement for the Economic Development Projects Support Program totalling $150,000 with the Minister of Economy, Innovation and Energy / Authorize an additional revenue and expenditure budget to the Economic Development Service of $1,122,240 allocated between 2026 and 2029 equivalent to the amount of the grant expected
entries.4ce9d15c626a61e191f56c3b62a3efb445aa06a5: In recent years, the work of the City's Economic Development Service has led to the identification of bio-food as a strategic sector. In line with this approach, the City and the Ministère de l'Agriculture, des Pêcheries et de l'Alimentation du Québec (MAPAQ) signed in 2019 an initial Bio-Food Sector Development Agreement (2019-2021) to jointly support certain projects that would meet the City's bio-food sector development objectives. In the context of the VOCID-19 pandemic, this first agreement had been extended until March 31, 2023 through an amendment.
entries.2a485bf4a07766046cf2dfad93babce608f2d6a3: Provide $220,500 in financial support to Les scènes de Musique Alternative du Québec (SMAQ) pour des projets de développement économique / Approve the draft convention for this purpose
entries.4b11ef96ac1b13e6556d8b45d2c46bd2f04b15c1: As part of its 2030 Economic Plan, the City of Montreal reaffirms its commitment to improving access and participation in economic life for the entire population. This commitment is particularly evident through strengthening the social economy, reducing territorial inequalities and promoting the participation of actors from under-represented groups. In this regard, this GDD aims to support projects related to Axis 4 of the 2030 Economic Plan, dedicated to the local and territorial economy, notably by strengthening the economic vitality of neighbourhoods, supporting local businesses and implementing economic initiatives throughout Montréal.
entries.ae44128aa9a175e3e19a90198d7e80424b0a6947: Provide $581,845 in financial support to the Coopérative d'habitation Monde-Uni to carry out the Acadia project, as part of the fund funded by contributions from the social component of the Regulations to improve the supply of social, affordable and family housing / Approve the draft convention to this effect
entries.41bc797a3da4ee2828b391b8b27dcb6c030ef266: The Coopérative d'habitation Monde-Uni, founded in 2013 at Parc-Extension, is developing community housing in collaboration with the CDH Group, a group of technical resources that has carried out nearly 300 projects totalling approximately 9,200 units. Supported by the Groupe d'action de Parc-Extension, the Coopérative is conducting two residential projects, one on 7965 Boulevard de l'Acadie. The Coopérative has submitted an application for municipal contribution under RCG 25-014, complementary to the Quebec Affordable Housing Program (PHAQ) – Component 3, for a new construction project using advanced prefabrication techniques.
entries.33dc19e1ecae297238992c36e90387ccc0701d12: Provide $5,407,736 in financial support to 15 organizations and $3,942,461 in additional support to 10 organizations for the implementation of their respective projects over a three-year period ending December 31, 2028, under the Homelessness and Inclusive Environments Program 2026-2028 / Approve draft agreements and addenda to this effect
entries.bab38c4cf5fa8692afec609786dc48c9a08b6f4c: The Itinerance and Inclusive Environments Programme (PIMI) is one of the mechanisms through which the City manages its activities in the area of homelessness, as part of its responsibilities related to cohabitation and social inclusion. It is structured around three areas: (1) Social inclusion of people living in homelessness; (2) Improving cohabitation in the public space and raising awareness about homelessness; and (3) Diversion, accompaniment in the judicial process at the municipal court, as well as reducing the impact of the judicial burden on persons living in homelessness. PIMI supports essential interventions for people living in homelessness and promotes a more harmonised presence in the public space.
entries.4b266844874cd7effa6967089043e6cc2d9c7926: Approve the proposed intermunicipal agreement between the City of Montreal, the City of Varennes and the City of Repentigny to provide a river shuttle service as part of the "Wheeling River" project
entries.a19e81f3bce07c42a339f769b69d07ecb69ffff5: VALIDATION Speaker and sense of intervention Other intervener and meaning of the intervention Stakeholders Reading: RESPONSIBLE DU DOSSIER Julie BOISVERT SUMMARY DECISION-MAKING IDENTIFICATION File # :1253163002 Organizational unit Arrondissement Rivière-des-Prairies - Pointe-aux-Trembles , responsible : Direction de la culture_des sports_des loisirs et du développement social , Division du développement social et des événements publics Level of decision-making Conseil d'agglomeration proposé : Competence Ancien compétence de la Communauté urbaine d'agglomeration : Project : - Subject : To ask the conseil d'agglomeration to approve the intermunicipal agreement between the cities of Varennes and Repentigny, aiming to mandate the Ville de Repentigny in order to offer a river shuttle service within the framework of the project "Fluve à vélo" offered in collaboration with the cities of Varennes and Repentigny.
entries.0b2a12bf0a0a87f24e9b098baf70b7ebfca4005a: Approve the draft financial assistance agreement between the Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing and the City, as part of the Flood Resilience and Adaptation Program to conduct studies for the Nicolet and Dézery watershed project
entries.ce687d428c0e5d47e9cfd937aa695a61f4b06d9d: The financial assistance agreement concerns the project aimed at solving recurring flood problems in the Nicolet and Dézerry watersheds located in the arrondissements of Ville-Marie and Mercier-Hochelaga-Maisonneuve, more specifically, it aims to define and evaluate measures and intervention areas where high capacity green infrastructure, resilient spaces and vulnerable building protection measures would be most effective. The maximum financial assistance under this agreement is $448,998.
entries.3f73fde0a0484d43d771f9161856c6f7cbc06493: Modify the source of funding for financial support to the Association des restaurateurs de rue du Québec (CG25 0371), in order to charge the expenditure of $25,000, including taxes, to Agreement Réflexe 3 (2025-2029) with the Ministère de l'Économie, de l'Innovation et de l'Énergie
entries.c9317668ac93f35c7b88c1ad214cc24704aac29a: The Agreement between the City of Montreal and the Ministère de l'Économie, de l'Innovation et de l'Énergie (MEIE) du Québec (Réflexe 2 - 2022-2025) authorizes the financing of projects until December 31, 2025. Following meetings with the MEIE concerning the use of funds provided for in this agreement, it has been confirmed that the City can use unused funds for projects ending no later than December 31, 2026. During the review of projects funded by Réflexe 2, it was found that part of the project "Cooking Street: motor of revival, inclusion and urban innovation" will be carried out in 2027.
entries.67f7872ca35e0bdae51e713a73a19593eeed1414: Ratify the allocation to the amount of $1,095,300 for agglomeration competencies recorded in the financial results for the year ended December 31, 2025, in respect of future benefits

entries.0dd5e804fe49682fa6acaf41c383b62f0b84c9db: Since the major work on the procurement function carried out in 2010, the City has had a unified and coherent framework for acquisitions. In 2011, the adoption of the City of Montreal's Responsible and Fair Procurement Policy (hereinafter "Policy") by the City Council, the approval of the Procurement Function Business Model by the Executive Committee and the declaration of competence by the City Council under section 85.5 of the Charter have led to the establishment of a single policy applicable throughout Montréal. This declaration of jurisdiction was renewed in 2023 (CM23-1290) for a period of five years.
entries.6f36bf5eaa386e11665f1ce7f81a877e394272db: Approve the Framework for Intervention for the Vitality of the Territory, required under the Agreement 2025-2028 of the Regional and Rural Fund - Component 2 - Territorial development concluded between the Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Habitation and the City of Montreal
entries.e5e751eabf845f4223ad61891b291422ba186496: Pursuant to section 126.2 of the Municipal Jurisdictions Act (hereinafter referred to as the "MCA") and section 19 (11.1) of the Act respecting the exercise of certain powers in certain agglomerations, the Montréal agglomeration has powers to promote local and regional development in its territory. In order to exercise these powers, the City may enter into agreements with the departments or agencies of the Government of Quebec and, where appropriate, other partners concerning its role and responsibilities, including the implementation of regional priorities and the adaptation of government activities to regional particularities. For these purposes, the City shall administer the sums entrusted to it under those agreements and have the powers necessary for their execution.
entries.003c910a48b595d19e00854612cec0b94988da62: Adoption - Regulations authorizing a loan of $10,538,000 to fund park development work for the Fort Lorette Archaeological Site
entries.57cdf3104371856b4e42d3009de213e2592061c0: The City of Montreal wishes to develop a public park in the Fort-Lorette listed site to highlight the site's history and riparian landscape. The property located in the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville was acquired by the City in 2018 due to its exceptional historical, archaeological and landscape interest and in response to the mobilization of the environment that called for its protection. In the same year, the Ministère de la Culture et des Communications du Québec (MCC) made this site an archeological site classified given the national importance of the discoveries associated with a Sulpician mission erected in the 17th century.
entries.290aada7c4c7825c6e3e988ed407702a30395644: Adoption - By-law authorizing a loan of $29,000,000 to finance redevelopment work for nature parks under the jurisdiction of the Town Council
entries.65ca785e7e3e6ecf18d93dbd97fdded6e6d70d4a: Adoption - Regulations Amending Regulations No. RCG 25-015 Amending the Cooperative and Non-Profit Housing Grant Regulations (AccessLogis Montréal) (02-102)
entries.77f4d4faa4b475ff4c0c2b33d291d3d1735731a0: In May 2025, by Decision Summary 1255687001, the Agglomeration Council (CG25 0530) adopted Regulation RCG 25-015 amending the Co-operative and Non-Profit Housing Subsidy Regulations (AccessLogis Montréal) [02-102]. This amendment introduces a new method of establishing the contingency reserve from a single initial contribution to annual contributions. Thus, the portion of rental income previously allocated to repaying the loan contracted to finance the original contribution must now be used for annual contributions.
entries.528e950f0b8d7d1b5a0899c7d0798c3214156e7f: Adoption - Regulations Amending the Agglomeration Council Regulations on Contract Management (RCG 18-024)
entries.a92461098b5a0fa11be100423049fea9b2bf3392: Adoption - Regulations Amending the Noise-related Noise Reduction Grant Regulations for Independent Showrooms of Less than 3000 Seats (RCG 24-036)
entries.d4d409b3a26630cc02b71604da8870191ea0d844: The Sound Harm Reduction Program for Independent Performing Rooms, established in November 2024, was originally designed to support approximately fifteen establishments between 2025 and 2027. Section 3 of the Regulations provides that: "The owner shall demonstrate that cultural programming in the performing arts relating to the independent performing theatre located in his building included, during the year preceding the filing of the application, at least 35 performances scheduled and published." The purpose of this decision-making document is to submit a draft regulation amending the eligibility criteria for the noise reduction program in independent rooms with less than 3000 seats in order to achieve the central objective of DG 2024-007, i.e. supporting rooms dealing with cohabitation issues.
entries.3bcf01f58397f6e4d3cd79ececb7b410e1a72478: Approve Regulation R-225 authorizing a loan of $45,800,000, to fund the Infrastructure Maintenance Capital Program for a 20-year term / Approve amendment to Book Capital Program 2026-2035
entries.fac912cad86cccaf973de6c2c91e295f216de665: Authorize the Service Loan Agreement between the City of Montreal and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, for the secondment of a police resource from the Ville de Montréal Police Service to the National Firearms Act Enforcement Support Team, for a period of three years, effective March 30, 2026 / Authorize an equivalent additional revenue and expense budget for $2026 of $136,260, as well as an adjustment to the budget base for subsequent years / Authorize the temporary increase in authorized strength of a sergeant-detective police position for the same period
entries.a8f443a4d558efc104bf80accb16ef083998e525: Since November 2001, the National Arms Enforcement Support Team (ENSALA) has been established to support front-line police services in gathering evidence necessary for the prosecution of individuals involved in the trafficking and criminal use of firearms. The ENSALA provides strategic support to police forces through a variety of expertise: investigative support, specialized training, criminological testing, firearms testing, expert witnesses, as well as access to national and international investigation networks; its members act as law enforcement officers, promoting the dissemination and adoption of best practices in firearms management.
entries.428fa3894cf4db938ec82d05c1d3953123318cc7: Appoint Céline-Audrey Beauregard, Mayor of Verdun District, as the borough representative on the Board of Directors of MTL SMEs Grand Sud-Ouest
entries.3f4307d26c1c2a393850b3095b4de4f57af74244: Appoint Mercedez Plante, elected from the borough of Outremont, to sit on the board of directors of SME-MTL Centre-Ville
entries.4ec6e96b30f46feaaf7380476e64cedb607d85b8: Under the general regulations of SME MTL Centre-Ville, it is envisaged that one director from among the municipal elected representatives in each of three of the four Montreal boroughs constituting the territory of intervention 4 will sit on its board of directors. The term of office of such directors ends with the initiation of municipal elections. In the case of Outremont, a principle of alternation between a member of the council of the Outremont borough and a member of the Westmount city council is provided for.
entries.4cb79e4e0cc0e5f36e89113d58f8cf2303844b4b: Appoint Danielle Myrand, District Mayor, as representative of the Borough of L'Île-Bizard–Sainte-Geneviève, to serve on the Board of Directors of SME-MTL West Island
entries.72707c2de3efd9ae8c2acc2d259312759e3982f5: SME MTL Ouest-de-l'Île is a not-for-profit organization that promotes the local and regional economic development of the West Island of Montreal. Among other things, it has a broad mandate to support and fund entrepreneurs and business leaders in the region. Its services are offered to businesses in the municipalities of Beaconsfield, Baie-d'Urfé, Dollard-Des-Ormeaux, Dorval, Kirkland, L-Île-Dorval, Pointe-Claire, Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue and Senneville, as well as those in the boroughs of Lachine, L-Île-Bizard - Sainte-Geneviève and Pierrefonds-Roxboro.
entries.f3431e163ac8e80800aad114d4a2db3c5c1e2a6f: Appoint Jocelyn Pauzé, City Councillor, Marie-Victorin District, as representative of Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie District, on the Board of Directors of MTL-Centre Est SMEs
entries.831d9d117dab79bc9f31c89d5f6be8b26af479ed: Appoint Vana Nazarian, elected from the borough of Saint-Laurent, to serve as a representative on the board of the local economic development organization, SME-MTL Centre Ouest
entries.c85de94bf12940fadaa4ff5579e1f226c19de587: Bill 28, which deals primarily with the implementation of certain provisions of the June 4, 2014 Budget Speech and aimed at returning to a balanced budget in 2015-2016, passed on April 20, 2015 as chapter 8 of the 2015 Acts, provides, through amendments to various provisions relating to municipal governance with respect to local and regional development, that the Montréal agglomeration must establish a point of service for the territory composed of that of the cities of Côte-Saint-Luc, Hampstead, Montréal- Ouest and Mont-Royal and that of the boroughs of Ahuntsic-Cartierville and Saint-Laurent. It has been agreed that the governance of this point of service will be established from the existing CLD Centre-Ouest organization whose composition will be adapted to provide for representation from each of the territories. The board of directors will be composed of 13 persons, 4 elected and 9 persons from the business community including the President.

entries.c80e682a2c615dae59acb017c4e038101823c48e: Exercise both 12-month extension options and authorize an additional expenditure of $307,526.60, including taxes, for ferry repair and replacement parts services under the contract awarded to USD Global Inc. (CM23,0257), increasing the total contract amount to $1,084,168.76, including taxes
entries.eb91c235c4ee12e18b16d0a47808a343029b94c5: Pursuant to section 85.5 of the Charter of the City of Montreal, metropolis of Quebec, since January 1, 2015, the municipal council of the City of Montréal has jurisdiction with respect to the removal, transportation and deposit of residual materials from boroughs, including the adoption of regulations, integrated operational planning, as well as the coordination of the management of tenders and the award of contracts (CM24 1122). Thus, the Environmental Service is responsible for planning and having contracts awarded for the repair of residual material collection tools intended for the Montreal population. Since November 1, 2018, the City of Montreal has been providing a service to repair collection tools for its entire population.
entries.c5ca4ee50af54b9bbb5c6a4e5e37856d8f93d374: Grant two contracts to 7574479 Canada inc. (Lot 1) and to Terrassement Technique Sylvain Labrecque inc. (Lot 2), for the supply and planting of trees in 2026-2027, watering and maintenance of these trees, as well as the replacement of certain trees planted over a period from 2026 to 2029 - Total expenditure of $2,456,590.55, including taxes - Public tender 25-21191 (8 Som.)
entries.4520ecb7b37a8eab20b18aede99671ab50abcd62: Since 2012, the Major Parks, Mount Royal and Sports Service (SMPMRS) has been coordinating an intensive tree planting plan in the public domain as part of the Canopy Enhancement Program, which adds to the plantation efforts already undertaken by the boroughs. This Urban Forest Management Plan program aims to increase canopy and enhance biodiversity. boroughs wishing to participate in this program submit a list of sites ready to receive a tree, specifying the selected gasoline, as well as other information requested by the SGPMRS.
entries.ff18975b79eda110a14ca3b744ab3e59512179ec: Grant an OTC contract to BiblioPresto.ca, sole source, for the renewal of subscription to the Eureka.cc digital database, for libraries in the 19 arrondissements of Montreal, for a period of three years, effective January 1, 2026 - Total expenditure of $409,161.88, including taxes
entries.2b3d200de91352590e7d4fbdf31da5ff06ddd6e3: Libraries in Montreal's 19 boroughs provide access to the digital database Eureka.cc, providing access to Quebec, Canadian and international journals and newspapers (e.g. Le Devoir, Le Monde, Le Figaro, L'Express, L'Actualité, le journal Les Affaires, etc.), as well as news feeds, television and radio transcripts, news websites and social media content. The collective agreement to subscribe to the Eureka.cc digital database expires on December 31, 2025, but its access has been extended for all Québec libraries that subscribe to it so as not to interrupt service to users. Negotiations for the new agreement ended on November 17, and the subscription campaign began on November 18, 2025.
entries.c76c2dd5416b2a4e810e7e3e490ab07f61ac5f46: Provide two OTC contracts to Innovative Interfaces Inc., a sole-source provider, for the renewal of the maintenance contract for the Sierra Integrated Library Management System and the renewal of the annual component and licence maintenance contract for the Sierra suite incorporating RFID technology for a three-year period - Total expenditure of $1,563,103.65, including taxes

entries.87a43d927500ff15d27d91f5de8c4b14bebb2e28: Grant a contract to Les Pavages Céka inc. for the replacement of lead water connections and roads (rehabilitation) in various streets in the arrondissements of Anjou, Mercier–Hochelaga-Maisonneuve, Montréal-Nord, Plateau-Mont-Royal, Rivière-des-Prairies–Pointe-aux-Trembles and Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie - Total expenditure of $14,167,491.18 including taxes - Public tender 524201 (5 sum)
entries.75f168d65c2e7ab3fd0562e6d625ccfc6b018742: The City of Montreal, through the Asset Management Directorate (AMD) of the Water Service (EE), wishes to carry out replacement work on lead water connections in accordance with Directive S-DRE-SE-D-2021-03. This work is part of the municipal strategy for efficient infrastructure and contributes to improving the quality of life of citizens. The specific objective of this work is to replace water connections currently made of lead.
entries.45c45c76a27b4326bd84d87ca3370d5b44ddc130: Contract with Uniroc Construction Inc. to plan and cover bus stops at various locations in the City of Montreal under the Highway Infrastructure Maintenance Program 2026 - Total expenditure of $723,833.27, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 527501 (9 sum)
entries.05983760a6bb95bbe2924c4ce25e1159a5a75867: Through its programs, the Road Infrastructure Service (SIRR) continues its mission to plan rehabilitation activities on the road network in order to maintain the level of service established throughout the life cycle of the various assets. All investments allocated to the protection of the arterial road network demonstrate the City of Montreal's commitment to improve both the comfort and safety of road users, the quality of life of citizens, and the efficiency of movement of people and goods. SIRR's Strategic Asset Management Division, through its Highway Infrastructure Maintenance Program (RMIP), aims to ensure the sustainability of investment in upgrading the condition of the road network and to extend the lives of pavements by applying better intervention techniques.
entries.ed1656f1795c1f86613cfcf99a6a273a3bf4a301: Contract to Construction NRC Inc. for lighting work at various locations in the borough of Ville-Marie - Total expenditure of $770,198.27, including taxes - Public Call for Bids 526601 (6 som.)
entries.0f0ba258eef68953aab2078f864b19f8fcf691bc: Award a contract to Insituform Technologies Limited for the rehabilitation of tidal sewer pipes in various streets in the arrondissements of Ahuntsic-Cartierville, Anjou, L'Île-Bizard–Sainte-Geneviève, Montréal-Nord, Pierrefonds-Roxboro and Saint-Laurent - Total expenditure of $3,318,238 including taxes - Public tender 524004 (3 som.)
entries.005d79d4b963e206bc85af3858c116ab46c0109e: Water Service (SE) Asset Management Directorate (AMD) is proposing the rehabilitation of sewage pipes by means of a sheathing technique, which forms part of the strategy for water management of high-performance infrastructure and is one of the interventions that contribute to improving community infrastructure and the quality of life of citizens.This trench-free sheathing technique represents many advantages, compared with more traditional methods for the reconstruction of sewer lines by excavation, such as: · significant reduction in execution costs compared to excavation reconstruction; · rapid completion of work; · reduction of disturbance on surrounding infrastructure; · speed of site reclamation; · reduction in disposal of soil and excavation materials; · reduction of greenhouse gas emissions compared to reconstruction by excavation; and · maintenance of traffic during construction.
entries.8681c4fae3d26963bf8e5035a1be528d42fdaf66: Award a contract to Insituform Technologies Limited for the rehabilitation of sewerage lines by cable in various streets of the City of Montreal, in the arrondissements of South West, Mercier–Hochelaga-Maisonneuve, Verdun and Ville-Marie - Total expenditure of $7,148,437.05, including taxes - Public tender 524003 (3 som.)
